title: Enterprise Architect
description:
**About the role**  

**Job Summary:**

As an Enterprise Architect at Tesco you lead the formulation, development and alignment of new and existing Technology with the Tesco Business Strategy to collectively deliver a simpler, flexible & sustainable architecture. You define, communicate and govern the enterprise architecture for Tesco by creating standards and guidance for Technology programmes and solutions in order to ensure  
it enables and delivers the Tesco Business Strategy.

**You will be responsible for**  

**In this job, I am accountable for:**

Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities:

* Fostering understanding of the current technology landscape and its impact on stakeholders:
* + Ensure we have models and materials that describe the landscape at a high-level and how it supports the business
  + Help colleagues of all levels to understand the bigger picture and their role / activities within it to aid decision making
* Evolving and embedding Technology strategy across Tesco Technology's functions:
* + Partnering technology engineering and product leadership to define target enterprise architecture that will improve our business for customers and colleagues in line with
* our business and Technology strategy and plans
* + Identify organisational requirements for the resources, structures and cultural changes necessary to support the delivery of the enterprise architecture
  + Identify the optimal approach to delivering Tesco business strategy while increasing agility and driving simplicity / cost efficiency over the short, medium and long-term.
  + Supporting portfolio and programme teams to contribute to planning activities utilising our broad understanding of Tesco, its technology landscape and broader industry /
* technology trends
* Guiding high-level delivery planning and solution design to deliver our strategic goals whilst ensuring we continuously deliver business value
* + Work in collaboration other teams to help ensure we design flexible, efficient and secure solutions
  + Lead and facilitate the creation of governing principles, policies, standards etc. to guide solution decision making for architecturally significant initiatives
  + Operate the architecture review, governance and exception processes
* Supporting successful delivery through the technology lifecycle, delivering business value and realising strategic goals.
* + On occasion, provide targeted support for initiatives with technical challenges during their delivery
* Evolving our federated architecture and design framework as part of the Technology delivery model

  
**You will need**  

**Key people and teams I work with in and outside of Tesco:**  

* + Build architecture capability and competency within Tesco in keeping with our emphasis on agile, DevOps and 'architecture is everyone's role' principles.
  + Create and operate an effective community to engage and educate Technology colleagues in enterprise and solution architecture topics
  + Proactively collaborate and communicate with Technology colleagues and delivery partners to drive awareness and interest
  + Build effective relationships with our Stores business and PLC group colleagues, and valued 3rd party partners.
* Head of Enterprise Architecture
* N/A (direct influence on major strategic investments as part of role)
* Day-to-day engagement with Engineering teams and directors
* Regular engagement with Product, Programme and Software Development
* principals and managers
* Colleagues and business stakeholders across Tesco
* Suppliers and 3rd parties

**Experience relevant for this job:**  

* Technology understanding across Software, Infrastructure, Security and Data
* Proven record of Technology delivery at Tesco scale
* Solution Shaping & Problem-Solving
* Successful use of Enterprise Architecture to shape strategic priorities
* Technology Strategy and Portfolio Steering
* Solution Architecture experience on major programmes
* Architecture Modelling
* Creation, communication and embedding of Technology strategy
* Technical Writing (Standards, Whitepapers & Cookbooks)
* Leading solution architecture governance / assurance
* Proficient Software and System Engineering (incl. Cloud)
* Hands on engineering experience
* Core Technology
* Development Lifcycle
* Product Methodologies
* Retail Technology Awareness
* Communication & Influencing
* Data Analytics & Insights
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving
* Finance & Procurement
* Curiosity & Learning
* Embracing and Enabling Change

**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** - Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Annual Bonus** - Opportunity to earn additional bonus, distributed as 2/3rd in compensation and 1/3rd in shares.

**Leave & Time-off** - Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary** - In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** - Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** - We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** - Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** - Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.

**About Us**  

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Position: Customer Success Manager

Location: Bengaluru / Gurugram

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Experience Required: 1 - 2 years

The Role

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager who thinks about revenue first. You will own customer outcomes, ensuring clients not only stay but grow. This is not a support role; it is a growth role. You will drive adoption, expansion, and retention across our portfolio of D2C and e-commerce brands.

Key Metrics

* **Net Revenue Retention:** Maintain >100% through cross-sells, upsells, and adoption.
* **Revenue Realization:** Ensure billing hygiene and predictable cash flows.
* **Account Retention:** Minimize churn through proactive engagement.
* **Product Adoption:** Drive feature usage and deepen value delivery.

Key Responsibilities

* **Customer Onboarding and Account Growth**
  + Lead smooth onboarding for new accounts and ensure early success.
  + Identify opportunities for upsell or cross-sell based on customer usage and goals.
  + Collaborate with founders and sales to grow account revenue.

* **Relationship Management and Retention**
  + Conduct monthly reviews with key accounts to surface wins and gaps.
  + Maintain a deep understanding of customer business goals and align product value accordingly.
  + Proactively identify churn risks and execute recovery plans.

* **Adoption and Enablement**
  + Educate customers on new features and AI use cases to drive adoption.
  + Build advocacy by driving success stories, testimonials, and case studies.
  + Partner with marketing to co-create webinars, product showcases, and user stories.

* **Revenue Operations and Reporting**
  + Track usage, retention, and billing metrics for each account.
  + Maintain accurate forecasting and ensure timely renewals and payments.
  + Provide structured feedback loops to product and growth teams.

Who You Are

You have a revenue-first mindset and get energy from growth numbers. You have managed accounts in a SaaS environment and understand client lifecycles. You love solving problems and spotting upsell opportunities before anyone else. You communicate clearly, think analytically, and act fast. You believe in ownership, not waiting for instructions.

Must-Have Skills

* Strong communication (written and verbal).
* Customer relationship management.
* Analytical problem solving.
* Project and stakeholder management.
* Data-driven decision-making.

Culture and Perks

* Once-a-year international offsite.
* High-trust, action-biased environment.
* Work directly with founders and leadership.
* Ownership of experiments from idea to revenue.

title: D2C Operations & Customer Experience
description:
MillD is looking for a highly experienced, analytical, and result-oriented D2C Operations & Customer Experience Manager to independently manage customer support, order fulfilment, logistics, RTO claims, billing reconciliation, and operational analytics.

The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience managing high-volume D2C operations and leading customer service teams while ensuring operational efficiency and customer satisfaction.

WE ARE HIRING

Senior Manager – D2C Operations & Customer Experience

Company: MillD – Earth’s Treasure Food Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 5–8 Years

Industry: D2C / E-commerce / FMCG

Employment Type: Full-Time

Salary Package: ₹7-8 LPA

Key Responsibilities:

1. D2C Order Management

\* Monitor daily orders received, processed, dispatched, delivered, cancelled, and returned.

\* Ensure timely order fulfilment and delivery.

\* Identify and resolve order processing and delivery issues.

\* Coordinate with warehouse, logistics, and finance teams.

2. Customer Care & Team Management

\* Lead and manage the customer service team.

\* Monitor customer complaints, escalations, refunds, and resolutions.

\* Track customer satisfaction, response times, and resolution rates.

\* Establish customer support SOPs and performance KPIs.

3. Logistics, RTO & Claims

\* Monitor RTO, NDR, delivery delays, and failed deliveries.

\* Handle lost, damaged, and missing shipment claims.

\* Coordinate with courier partners for claims and dispute resolution.

\* Improve delivery success rates and reduce logistics costs.

4. Billing & Reconciliation

\* Monitor COD collections and payment settlements.

\* Reconcile logistics invoices, shipping charges, and claims.

\* Track pending refunds, courier claims, and outstanding payments.

\* Identify billing discrepancies and revenue leakage.

5. Data Analytics & MIS

\* Prepare detailed daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.

\* Build automated dashboards using Excel, Power BI, or Google Sheets.

\* Analyse order trends, delivery performance, RTO, customer complaints, and operational costs.

\* Present actionable insights and improvement plans to management.

6. Process Improvement & Automation

\* Develop operational SOPs and monitoring systems.

\* Implement CRM, ticketing, and workflow automation.

\* Improve team productivity and operational efficiency.

\* Take complete ownership of issue resolution and process improvements.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

\* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations, Commerce, or a related field; MBA preferred.

\* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in D2C/e-commerce operations.

\* Experience managing 1,000+ orders per day.

\* Strong working knowledge of Shopify, GoKwik, Delhivery, Shiprocket, and CRM platforms.

\* Advanced Excel, Google Sheets, and Power BI skills.

\* Strong understanding of RTO, NDR, COD reconciliation, logistics billing, and claims.

\* Proven experience managing customer service teams.

\* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and leadership skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

\* Order fulfilment and delivery success rate

\* RTO and NDR reduction

\* Customer complaint resolution time

\* Customer satisfaction (CSAT)

\* Logistics claims recovery

\* COD and billing reconciliation accuracy

\* Customer care team productivity

\* Daily MIS reporting accuracy

Work Location: In person

title: Mgr, Technical Account Management 3
description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

**Mgr, Technical Account Management 3**
=======================================

Bengaluru, India

**Job category:** Customer Support **Job ID:** 136819-en\_US

**Job Summary**
---------------

This role leads the delivery and success of Technical Account Management (TAM) and Support Account Management (SAM) services for NetApp customers. The manager develops a high-performing team, ensures consistent post-sales outcomes, and provides leadership oversight for the customer experience. The manager is accountable for team performance, service quality, customer outcomes, adoption, operational health, capacity, and execution against business priorities.

Success in this role requires demonstrating NetApp’s High Achievement Principles through leadership in innovation, execution, and teamwork.

**Innovate to Elevate** — shows curiosity & a growth mindset, challenges the status quo, uses data, tools, & AI to simplify work & scales best practices.

**Drive Results** — sets clear priorities & outcomes, holds self & team accountable, makes timely fact-based decisions, manages risk & delivers with discipline.

**Excel as a Team** — builds trust, coaches diverse talent, collaborates across functions, removes blockers & fosters an inclusive, high-performing team.

**Key responsibilities include**
--------------------------------

* Drives adoption, value realization, retention, and growth of NetApp Lifecycle Management Services across the assigned portfolio.

* Leads, coaches, and develops a high-performing TAM/SAM team with clear expectations and accountability.

* Leads change by clearly communicating the purpose, engaging stakeholders, addressing adoption barriers, and measuring sustained business impact.

* Champions innovation and continuous improvement through standardization, simplification, and automation.

* Ensures the team develops and executes strategic customer success plans aligned with customer goals, measurable outcomes, and NetApp priorities.

* Manages resources and capacity to ensure coverage, prioritization, and timely delivery.

* Builds trusted relationships with customers and internal stakeholders to strengthen adoption, demonstrate value, resolve risks, and create customer advocates.

**Skills & Competencies**
-------------------------

* Strong operational discipline to define, inspect, and improve service health and delivery metrics through recurring reviews and data-driven actions.

* Ability to provide leadership oversight for major or executive-level escalations, make informed decisions, and mobilize the appropriate specialists.
* Ability to ensure measurable customer success plans and repeatable TAM/SAM practices across the portfolio.
* Ability to standardize and improve service-delivery processes by using data, automation, and continuous-improvement methods to increase quality, consistency, and scale.

* Effective resource and capacity management to align coverage and priorities with commitments and outcomes.

* Ability to translate complex issues into clear recommendations and actionable executive updates.
* Proven experience coaching and developing direct reports, setting clear expectations, addressing performance gaps, and building an inclusive, high-performing team.
* Leadership experience supporting global customers and stakeholders, with the ability to adapt delivery, communication, and resource decisions to regional and market dynamics.

* Change leadership that builds alignment, drives adoption, and delivers results in fast-moving environments.

* Ability to build trust, navigate difficult conversations, and adapt communication and influencing approaches across audiences and priorities.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, including at least 2 years of people management experience with direct reports.
* Experience in customer-facing, post-sales roles within enterprise technology, such as Customer Success, Technical Support, Professional Services, or account delivery, with responsibility for managing or leading technical teams such as TAM/SAM, support, or services teams.
* Experience driving operational cadences, using key performance indicators to inspect service delivery and team performance, and taking corrective action when results fall short.
* Experience partnering with Sales, Support, Services, and Product teams to deliver customer outcomes and resolve complex issues.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication, including proactively raising risks, providing clear recommendations, and delivering actionable updates.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Expertise in data infrastructure, including storage, data management, and cloud/hybrid architectures, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into customer value.
* Familiarity with customer success and service management tools such as Salesforce, Gainsight, ServiceNow, and dashboard-driven operations.
* Executive presence and experience leading QBRs/EBRs and influencing senior stakeholders.
* Experience leading operating model change, process standardization, and continuous improvement at scale.
* Use of automation, AI, and digital workflows to improve productivity, quality, and customer experience.

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process.

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment—you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure.

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security.

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed—they drive everything we do.

title: ERP Specialist
description:
**Req ID:** 393767
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a ERP Specialist to join our team in Bangalore, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
Senior System Architect (Pega)
  
  
**Department:** IT / Digital Transformation
  
**Location:** Hybrid
  
**Experience Level:** 5–8+ Years
  
**Employment Type:** Full-time
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Pega Senior System Architect (SSA) to design, develop, and implement enterprise-grade BPM and case management solutions using the Pega Platform. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Pega application architecture, best practices, integration strategies, and performance optimization, and will play a key role in leading technical design and mentoring team members.
  
  
The SSA will collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, maintainable, and high-performance Pega applications.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Solution Design Architecture
  

* Design and implement end-to-end Pega solutions aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Define application layer structure, class hierarchy, case types, data models, and integration patterns.
* Ensure adherence to Pega Guardrails and best practices.
* Conduct design and code reviews to ensure quality and performance.

Development Implementation
  

* Develop complex case workflows, UI rules, data pages, decision rules, and integrations.
* Implement REST/SOAP integrations, connectors, and services.
* Configure and optimize decisioning, routing, SLAs, and business rules.
* Implement security, access control, and authentication mechanisms.
* Support DevOps practices including CI/CD and deployment automation.

Performance Optimization
  

* Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks.
* Optimize database queries, reports, and background processing.
* Ensure application scalability and high availability.

Collaboration Leadership
  

* Provide technical leadership to Pega developers and System Architects.
* Mentor junior team members and review deliverables.
* Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and backlog refinement.
* Work closely with Business Architects and stakeholders for requirement clarification.
* Support UAT and production deployment activities.

Governance Compliance
  

* Ensure compliance with organizational standards and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain documentation for architecture, integrations, and deployment processes.
* Conduct guardrail compliance reviews and quality assurance checks.

Required Qualifications
  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
* 5–8+ years of IT experience with Pega application development
* Strong experience with:
* Pega PRPC / Pega Platform (v7.x / v8.x or above)
* Case Management and BPM concepts
* Data modelling and class structure design
* Integration services (REST, SOAP, JMS, Kafka, etc.)
* Pega Decisioning and business rules
* UI/UX configuration using Pega UI frameworks
* Strong understanding of Pega guardrails and performance tuning.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Pega Senior System Architect (CSSA/SSA) certification – Mandatory
* Pega Lead System Architect (CLSA) – Preferred
* Experience with:
* Pega Customer Service / Sales Automation / Smart Dispute (if applicable)
* Cloud deployments (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* DevOps tools (Jenkins, Git, Azure DevOps, etc.)
* Database systems (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL)
* Microservices architecture
* Experience in large-scale enterprise implementations.

Technical Skills
  

* Case lifecycle design
* Data pages and data transforms
* Activities and utility functions
* Decision tables, decision trees, and declarative rules
* Report definitions and performance optimization
* Authentication (OAuth, SSO, LDAP)
* Background processing and queue processors
* Pega Deployment Manager

Soft Skills
  

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to lead technical discussions and design workshops
* Strong documentation skills
* Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams
* Mentorship and team leadership capabilities

Key Competencies
  

* Solution Architecture
* Enterprise Integration
* Performance Engineering
* Technical Leadership
* Agile Delivery
* Risk Mitigation

We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. **Role Title: VP, IAM End User Operations (L14)**

  
  

**Company Overview:**

Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are

shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.

  
  

**Organizational Overview:**

The Identity and Access Management (IAM) team at Synchrony, led by the Head of IAM reporting to the CISO, oversees key security functions. Direct reports specialize in authentication, authorization, privileged access management, special programs, and federated controls governance. This structure ensures comprehensive management of identity and access processes to maintain robust security and compliance across the organization. This role will be a direct report into the Head of IAM.

  
  

**Role Summary/Purpose:**

The Synchrony Identity and Access Management (IAM) team is seeking an experienced IAM End User Operations leader to oversee and drive the operations and support of End User IAM Services. This role will lead a team responsible for delivering secure, efficient, and seamless identity and access management experiences for our end users across the organization. Acting as a critical bridge between technology, security, and business stakeholders, you will ensure operational excellence of IAM solutions, streamline user lifecycle processes, and enhance service delivery aligned with our digital transformation goals.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

The ideal candidate for this role will embrace the exciting blend of technical expertise, program management, engagement ability and leadership that is required to be successful.

Specifically,

* Lead and manage the IAM End User Operations team focused on End User Services, including IAM automation engineers, administrators, and support specialists.
* Oversee day-to-day operations of user identity lifecycle management, access provisioning/de-provisioning, access reviews, self-service workflows, and password management tools.
* Drive continuous improvement in IAM operations by optimizing automation, workflows, and integration with IT service management (ITSM) platforms.
* Collaborate closely with IAM Solution Architects, Security, IT infrastructure, and business partners to ensure operational readiness, platform health, and scalability of IAM solutions.
* Develop and enforce operational standards, SLAs, and KPIs to monitor service performance and user experience quality.
* Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and problem resolution efforts related to end-user identity and access issues.
* Ensure compliance with security policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements (SOX, GDPR, PCI, NIST).
* Champion adoption of best practices around zero trust, privileged access, and identity governance in daily operations.
* Provide leadership, mentorship, and professional development opportunities for the operations team.
* Partner with automation and DevSecOps teams to deploy and maintain infrastructure-as-code and automated IAM provisioning processes.
* Facilitate communication and training for end-users and support teams to improve IAM awareness and compliance.
* Stay current with emerging IAM operational technologies, tools, and industry trends to continuously enhance the IAM service portfolio.
  

  

**Required Skills/Knowledge**:

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.
* Proven experience leading or managing teams responsible for IAM service delivery, identity lifecycle management, and end-user access support.
* Strong communication skills and executive presence needed.
* Knowledge of IAM tool platforms used for standard and privileged access management as well as authentication (ie. Delinea, Okta, SailPoint IIQ)
* Strong working knowledge of IAM tools such as SailPoint, Okta, Beyond Identity, Delinea, Microsoft Entra ID, and directory services like Active Directory.
* Experience managing identity provisioning, password resets, authentication services, and access governance activities at scale.
* Solid understanding of identity protocols (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, LDAP, SCIM) in operational contexts.
* Familiarity with cloud IAM models (AWS, Azure, GCP) and integrating hybrid IAM ecosystems operationally.
* Knowledge of automation tools and DevSecOps principles applied in IAM environments (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD).
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills with proven stakeholder management experience.
* Demonstrated commitment to exceptional customer service and continuous operational improvement.
* Experience working within regulatory frameworks affecting IAM operations such as SOX IT-404, GDPR, PCI, and financial industry controls.
  

  

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**:

* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, Okta Certified Administrator, SailPoint IdentityIQ Engineer, or similar.
* Experience managing large-scale IAM operational teams in financial services or regulated industries.
* Knowledge of Zero Trust principles as applied to IAM operations.
* Self-starter, able to adapt and thrive in a fast-changing, dynamic environment.
  

  

**Eligibility Criteria:**

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field; Master’s degree preferred with 10+ years of IT experience with a minimum of 8 years focused on IAM operations and end-user services management.

  
  

**Work Timings**: 2:00 PM - 11:00 PM IST

description:

Shift Timings: US Shift | 6:00 PM – 3:00 AM IST

Experience: 5+ Years

**Company Overview**

Sarder Inc. is a global family of innovative companies united by a bold vision — to educate and certify over one billion people worldwide. We are redefining lifelong learning through a diverse portfolio that spans corporate training, AI certifications, eLearning, proctoring solutions, and thought-leadership media.

Our ecosystem includes NetCom Learning, NetCom+, AI CERTs, AI Labs 365, Adoptify AI, and Sarder TV, each contributing to our mission of shaping a future-ready workforce in an AI-driven world. With a strong culture of innovation and continuous learning, Sarder Inc. empowers individuals and organizations to upskill, stay relevant, and thrive in a rapidly evolving digital era.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a results-driven Customer Success Manager to strengthen customer relationships, drive account growth, and maximize customer value across our EdTech and corporate learning business.

In this role, you will manage existing customer relationships, identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling, engage key decision-makers, and own weekly and monthly revenue targets. You will work closely with internal teams to ensure customer satisfaction, encourage repeat business, and build long-term partnerships.

This is an individual contributor role, with support from the Training Coordinator and T4H team. Team management experience is not required at this stage.

**What's in it for You**

  

* Work with international customers, particularly across the US market.
* Build relationships with key decision-makers and senior stakeholders.
* Drive account growth through upselling, cross-selling, and customer retention.
* Work with industry-leading IT training, certification, and workforce development solutions.
* Use AI tools to improve customer research, communication, and productivity.
* Gain exposure to revenue ownership, customer success strategy, and consultative account management.
* Grow with a global learning organization focused on innovation and continuous development.

**What Will You Do**

  

* Manage and strengthen relationships with existing customers to improve engagement, retention, and long-term value.
* Identify and execute upselling and cross-selling opportunities across NetCom Learning's training, certification, and corporate learning solutions.
* Engage key decision-makers and stakeholders to understand business requirements, training needs, and organizational goals.
* Own and achieve weekly and monthly revenue targets through account growth and customer engagement.
* Develop customer success plans to increase customer satisfaction, repeat business, and account revenue.
* Proactively reconnect with existing and past customers to identify new business opportunities.
* Understand customer challenges and recommend relevant learning solutions aligned with their workforce development needs.
* Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Training Coordination, and other internal teams to ensure smooth service delivery.
* Monitor customer engagement, account performance, revenue progress, and potential risks; take proactive action where needed.
* Handle customer concerns and escalations professionally, ensuring timely resolution and a positive customer experience.
* Maintain accurate customer records, opportunity updates, and revenue reports in the relevant CRM or internal systems.
* Leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Microsoft Copilot for customer research, communication, and workflow efficiency.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Functional Skills**

  

* Strong Customer Success experience within the EdTech industry, preferably in corporate learning, IT training, certification, or workforce development.
* Hands-on experience in upselling and cross-selling, account growth, and customer relationship management.
* A target-driven mindset with proven ownership of revenue or commercial KPIs.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to engage decision-makers and senior stakeholders and build long-term customer partnerships.
* Exposure to US-based clients and international customer management; UK market exposure is also an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Microsoft Copilot.
* Ability to work independently, manage customer accounts, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Experience in a consulting firm or consulting-led business environment is an added advantage.

**Education & Experience**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 5+ years of relevant professional experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or a similar customer-facing commercial role.
* Core EdTech Customer Success experience is mandatory.
* Demonstrated experience in upselling, cross-selling, and achieving revenue targets.
* Experience managing US clients is preferred; UK client exposure is an advantage.

**Why Join NetCom Learning?**

  

* Opportunity to work with global customers and industry-leading learning solutions.
* Exposure to technology training, professional certifications, and emerging AI-driven learning.
* A performance-oriented environment with ownership of customer relationships and revenue outcomes.
* Collaborative support from internal teams, including Training Coordination and T4H.
* Opportunities for professional development and career growth within the Sarder Inc. ecosystem.

If you are passionate about customer success, building lasting client relationships, and driving business growth through upselling and cross-selling, we would love to hear from you. Join NetCom Learning and help organizations build future-ready teams through learning.

title: Outbound SDR - India
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

This is an outbound Sales Development role based in our Bangalore office. You’ll build a pipeline for our Account Executives by researching target accounts, reaching decision-makers by phone, email, and LinkedIn, and booking qualified meetings.

The role is fully focused on top-of-funnel prospecting. It suits someone who enjoys high activity, quick feedback, clear daily goals, and a team where results are visible and celebrated. You won’t be handling inbound leads or closing deals.

Along the way you’ll learn Rippling’s full platform and the operational problems our customers deal with every day. Strong SDRs here build real skill in prospecting, discovery, objection handling, and territory management, which sets them up for the next step in their sales career.

**Note:**

* You’ll work Indian business hours i.e. 9am to 5pm IST.
* Hybrid: in the Bangalore office 3 days a week (Monday, Tuesday, Thursday).

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Research target companies, personas, and business triggers to find strong prospecting opportunities
* Run a high-volume outbound motion: daily call blocks, multi-touch sequences, email follow-ups, and account research
* Hit clear activity goals, typically 80 to 100 calls and 40 to 50 emails a day depending on territory priorities
* Qualify prospects against defined criteria and book quality meetings for Account Executives
* Work closely with your AEs and manager on territory strategy, account prioritization, and messaging
* Join weekly enablement sessions, call reviews, and 1:1 coaching, and put the feedback to use quickly
* Keep Salesforce accurate and up to date
* Use Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and our dialer to work efficiently

**What you will need**
----------------------

* 1 to 2 years as an outbound SDR at a SaaS company, prospecting into India
* Hands-on experience in tools like Salesforce, Outreach, or ZoomInfo
* Strong communication, especially on the phone and in short, sharp written outreach
* A results-driven mindset: you move with urgency, go after quota, and are persistent in finding new business
* Comfort in a fast-paced environment and with learning a complex, evolving product
* Coachability: you take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative: you ask good questions and find ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high-activity, competitive team where performance is visible

**What success looks like**

* Month 1: onboarding on our product, customers, sales methodology, tools, and messaging
* Month 2: live prospecting begins, with a focus on activity consistency and a partial quota
* Month 3: full ramp, managing your own daily outbound activity and booking qualified meetings consistently
* Beyond: building the skills and track record to grow at Rippling, whether that’s toward an Account Executive role, SDR leadership, or another go-to-market path

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

title: Business Improvement Lead
description:
**Business Improvement Lead**
=============================

Req ID: 126267

Department: GO - Transformation Office - TDH

Division: Group Operations

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

The Senior Manager, Business Analysis Practice is accountable for leading the Business Analysis Practice within the Transformation Delivery Hub (TDH), ensuring the profession is equipped to deliver high-quality analysis, stakeholder engagement, problem-solving and business design outcomes across ANZ.

  

Reporting directly to the General Manager, Transformation Delivery Hub, the role provides leadership across business analysis capability, professional standards, workforce insights, communities of practice and analysis excellence initiatives. The role acts as the principal subject matter expert and advocate for the business analysis profession, shaping practice direction, influencing analysis standards and driving capability uplift across the Transformation Delivery Hub.

  

The role also provides independent guidance, professional oversight and constructive challenge to delivery teams and leaders, helping ensure initiatives are underpinned by robust analysis, clearly defined business outcomes, well-articulated requirements and effective stakeholder engagement strategies. Through practice insights, reviews and health assessments, the role identifies opportunities to strengthen problem definition, solution design, scope management and business readiness, improving the likelihood of successful delivery outcomes.

  

Working closely with delivery leaders, practice leads and senior stakeholders, the role promotes contemporary business analysis approaches, supports workforce and capability planning, and builds a high-performing professional community that attracts, develops and retains business analysis talent. The role acts as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, influencing analysis approaches, team structures and capability decisions to improve delivery effectiveness and value realisation across the transformation portfolio.

  

Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.

  

Role Location: Bengaluru

Role Type: Permanent

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

* Lead the Business Analysis Practice and act as the recognised leader of the profession within the Transformation Delivery Hub
* Define and maintain the vision, priorities and improvement roadmap for the Business Analysis Practice
* Drive adoption of contemporary business analysis approaches, standards and industry best practices
* Provide thought leadership on business analysis capability, organisational maturity and emerging industry trends
* Provide expert advice, coaching and constructive challenge to practitioners, delivery teams and leaders on complex delivery matters
* Review and challenge delivery approaches, team structures and resourcing models to ensure alignment with delivery objectives and organisational standards
* Identify emerging delivery risks, capability gaps and performance issues, escalating and recommending corrective actions where appropriate
* Support teams to resolve complex challenges and strengthen the likelihood of achieving planned outcomes, milestones and benefits
* Support capability models, role profiles and career pathways for business analysis professionals
* Lead practice-wide capability assessments and identify opportunities to strengthen organisational capability
* Partner with Talent & Culture and Workforce Planning teams to identify future capability requirements and talent strategies
* Seek to continuously improve business analysis frameworks, standards, methods, tools and guidance materials
* Provide expert guidance on analysis practices, business problem definition, value identification and requirements quality
* Analyse lessons learned, practice performance indicators and stakeholder feedback to drive continuous improvement

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:

  

* Demonstrated success in leading large and diverse teams, building organisational capability, and establishing performance frameworks that drive accountability, growth, and sustained business outcomes.
* Significant experience leading or developing business analysis capability, business architecture, process improvement, requirements management or professional practice functions within a regulated organisation
* Experience designing and implementing capability frameworks, learning pathways, accreditation programs or professional development initiatives
* Strong expertise in requirements management, stakeholder engagement, process modelling, business design and solution assessment
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving enterprise adoption of new practices, standards and ways of working
* Experience establishing or leading Communities of Practice, mentoring programs or capability uplift initiatives
* Experience conducting capability assessments, practice maturity reviews, lessons learned reviews or continuous improvement activities
* Familiarity with analysis and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Miro, Visio, Signavio, ARIS, LeanIX or similar
* Experience with business architecture, operating model design or business process management
* Understanding of data analysis, business intelligence and information management practices
* Passion for growing capability, developing people and advancing the business analysis profession
* Degree in Business, Commerce, Technology, Economics or related discipline

  

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.

**Job Posting End Date**
------------------------

title: Senior People Operations Specialist
description:
India - Bangalore

People Team/Full time/Hybrid

Are you looking to work in an environment, where you have the ability to own, create and improve People Operations Best Practices in multiple countries?
  
Do you enjoy finding solutions to People Operations challenges?
  
Are you interested in continuously learning and deepening your international HR knowledge in a Global organization?
  
If you answer yes to these types of questions, we have an exciting opportunity for you! We are looking for Senior People Operations Specialist to join our Global People Operations Team and be a part of our incredible growth story.

**Job Description**

**What you will be doing**

  
  

* Serve as the first point of contact for employees and managers in APAC on People-related questions, policies, and processes.
* Partner closely with People Business Partners to understand functional strategy for the region and translate it into day-to-day People support, programs, and initiatives.
* Collaborate with Employee Experience to support onboarding, New Hire Orientation, engagement initiatives, internal communications, and other programs that shape the regional employee experience.
* Work with Compensation & Benefits to support annual compensation programs and benefits administration, ensuring alignment with global frameworks and local market practices.
* Manage the delivery and continuous improvement of key People processes, including employee lifecycle changes, payroll readiness, time off and absence, and People system data changes. Assess current-state processes, identify gaps and opportunities, and partner cross-functionally to design and implement scalable, automated solutions.
* Provide guidance to managers in line with labour law, internal policies, and company values; and escalate complex cases to People Business Partners and Employee Relations as appropriate.
* Ensure all People practices and documentation comply with local labour law, data privacy regulations and company standards; keeping current on changes in India and regional employment law and market trends.
* Manage offboarding and exits across supported countries, ensuring consistent, compliant processes and accurate Payroll inputs.
* Support People reporting and analytics requirements (headcount, turnover, engagement insights, etc.) and use data to identify trends and recommend actions.
* Contribute to regional and global People projects and process improvements, representing the region perspective and employee voice.
* Ability to work in a hybrid environment, with a minimum of three days per week in our Bengaluru office. Effectively manage collaboration across multiple time zones, including evening calls to accommodate EMEA and US team members.
  

  

**What you bring**

  
  

* 5+ years relevant People Operations experience, with a strong understanding of labour law and People practices in APAC (employment contracts, working hours, leave, separations, etc.), ideally in a SaaS/technology or global matrixed organization and fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships and collaborate effectively with employees, managers, and cross-functional People teams across different regions and cultures.
* High accountability and ability to work independently, managing confidential information and triage employee relations matters with good judgment and discretion.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail; comfortable managing multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify process gaps, recurring issues, and compliance risks and recommend practical and innovative improvements.
* Strong hands-on Workday experience, including business-process execution and data maintenance, plus experience with ServiceNow or a similar case management system.
* Experience using automation and AI to improve HR service delivery, with a proactive interest in adopting new tools and ways of working is a strong plus.

Interested in this position?

Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

  
  

As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600+ successful projects, supported by the largest R&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Our Marketplace provides hundreds of applications that accelerate integration, localization, and innovation.

title: Senior Workday Integrations Product Engineer
description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**

**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** **At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**

**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**

**Your Role: Sr** **Workday Integrations Product Engineer**

Working closely with Product Management, Product Design, HR technology teams, enterprise architecture, security, and other engineering teams, you will take end-to-end engineering ownership of Workday integrations and the services that connect Workday with our broader enterprise technology landscape. This is a hands-on engineering role with a strong focus on **Workday integration development, architecture, automation, reliability, security, observability, and operational excellence**.

**Your Responsibilities:**

**Workday Integration Engineering**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and support robust integrations between Workday and enterprise applications.
* Build and maintain integrations using **Workday Studio, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Workday Web Services, REST/SOAP APIs, PECI, and WECI**.
* Design appropriate integration patterns based on business requirements, data volumes, security requirements, reliability, and maintainability.
* Develop integrations between Workday and downstream/upstream platforms using middleware technologies such as **Boomi** and cloud services.
* Perform integration analysis, data mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.

**Architecture & Engineering Excellence**

* Contribute to the evolution of the Workday integration architecture, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, reusable, and maintainable.
* Identify opportunities to simplify existing integrations and reduce technical debt.
* Establish reusable integration patterns, engineering standards, and development best practices.
* Participate in technical design reviews and contribute to architectural decisions across the HR technology ecosystem.
* Apply strong software engineering principles including version control, peer review, automated testing, CI/CD, and structured release management.

**Reliability, Monitoring & Automation**

* Build integrations with **observability and operational resilience by design**.
* Implement proactive monitoring, alerting, logging, reconciliation, and automated recovery mechanisms.
* Develop solutions for intelligent error handling and, where appropriate, automated or self-healing recovery.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues and perform root-cause analysis to prevent recurrence.
* Continuously improve integration reliability, performance, supportability, and operational efficiency.

**Security & Data Integrity**

* Ensure integrations comply with enterprise security, privacy, and data governance requirements.
* Protect sensitive employee and personal information throughout the integration lifecycle.
* Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure data-transfer mechanisms.
* Build appropriate controls for data validation, reconciliation, auditability, and integrity.

**Product & DevOps Collaboration**

* Work as part of an **Agile Product Engineering team**, partnering closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, HR stakeholders, and other engineering teams.
* Own solutions throughout their lifecycle — from discovery and technical design through development, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement.
* Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions while challenging requirements where simpler or more sustainable approaches are available.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, technical planning, and product roadmap discussions.
* Collaborate across global teams and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**

* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong hands-on experience developing and supporting **Workday integrations** in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong experience with **Workday Studio** and Workday integration technologies.
* Experience with integration patterns including **PECI and WECI**.
* Experience working with Workday Web Services, REST/SOAP APIs, XML/XSLT, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience with an enterprise integration platform such as **Boomi**.
* Strong understanding of integration architecture, APIs, event-driven integration, and data transformation.
* Workday Extend or broader Workday platform capabilities.
* Experience supporting Workday integrations in a large, global enterprise.

**What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):**

* Experience troubleshooting complex integration and production issues.
* Strong understanding of security, data privacy, and data integrity principles.
* Experience working within Agile and DevOps delivery models.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively across product, engineering, business, and vendor teams.

**Additional Skills/Preferences**

Experience in one or more of the following would be advantageous:

* Cloud platforms such as **GCP or Microsoft Azure**.
* CI/CD and automated deployment practices.
* Monitoring, observability, and automated operational tooling.
* ServiceNow or similar IT service management platforms.
* Power BI or other reporting/analytics technologies.
* Experience modernizing legacy integrations and reducing integration technical debt.

**Additional Information:**

* Travel: 0%
* Location: India, Bangalore

title: Lead Customer Service Experience Manager
description:
BASIC PURPOSE:
  
The Lead Customer Service Experience Manager is the interface for Customer Care with regards to communicating department objectives, processes, and performance.
  
  
This position assumes a lead role ensuring customer expectations and department objectives align, and managing escalations when discrepancies arise, by being accountable for timely resolution while also maintaining the client relationship.
  
  
A positive and productive relationship is maintained by employing deep cross-functional knowledge of the organization, as well as historically proven resolution paths.

Are you a problem solver? Do you like figuring out how things work and talking with others to share your knowledge? Would you like to work in an international team?

Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific partners with the pharmaceutical industry to gather and organize clinical trial data, leading to quicker, more reliable trial outcomes. Our contribution to improving patients' lives motivates us every day!

Join our Bangalore team as a **Lead Customer Service Experience Manager** to provide world class customer service & support of clinical trials deployed at hundreds of clinical sites worldwide.

  

You will be part of a growing team in Bangalore, working directly with our clients and Clario colleagues across the globe - helping to bring new drugs to market, more quickly and more safely. See the impact you could have.

**What we offer**

* Competitive compensation + shift allowances
* Attractive benefits (security, flexibility, support and well-being)
* Engaging employee programs
* Technology for hybrid working and great onsite facilities

**What you'll be doing**

  

* Serve as the primary escalation point for high-priority customer issues and ensure timely resolution while maintaining exceptional customer satisfaction.
* Establish clear expectations with customers and internal stakeholders and align outcomes with departmental objectives, procedures, and business priorities.
* Lead solution-oriented escalation management by assessing business impact, coordinating cross-functional resources, and driving issues to successful resolution.
* Partner with customers to understand underlying business challenges and distinguish between what customers request and what they truly need, providing recommendations that deliver the best outcomes.
* Effectively manage customer expectations and confidently challenge unrealistic requests while maintaining positive, professional relationships.
* Conduct regular customer meetings and business reviews to discuss risks, service performance, quality improvements, customer satisfaction, and emerging business needs.
* Analyze escalation trends, identify root causes, and develop corrective and preventive action plans that improve customer experience and operational efficiency.
* Develop and execute cross-functional process improvement initiatives by identifying stakeholders, defining required changes, documenting processes, and driving implementation.
* Lead change management activities, including stakeholder identification, communication planning, accountability tracking, implementation oversight, and post-implementation effectiveness reviews.
* Collaborate with Customer Care leadership and business stakeholders to implement resolution strategies and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Leverage data, reporting tools, and AI technologies such as Microsoft Copilot to generate insights, identify trends, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Monitor customer experience metrics and prepare executive-level reports, dashboards, presentations, and business reviews for internal and external stakeholders.
* Develop, document, and maintain SOPs, policies, workflows, and best practices to improve service quality, consistency, and operational effectiveness.
* Drive governance activities and special projects focused on improving customer satisfaction, operational performance, and service excellence.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, coaching, and guidance to Customer Service Experience Coordinators, Customer Service Managers, and other team members.
* Support department leadership as a subject matter expert in customer experience management, escalation processes, and continuous improvement practices.

**What we're looking for**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in electronics or technical school or equivalent experience.
* LEAN or ITIL certification.
* Agile certification.
* Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and related software.
* 5 or more years of experience in escalation management, client success or customer experience management, preferably in customer care, clinical trials or related industries.
* 5 or more years of experience in Clario processes and tools and Customer Care department.
* A minimum of 4 years of service as a Customer Service Experience Manager or equivalent experience.
* Excellent communication skills in English; proficiency in other languages is a plus.
* Strong problem-solving and organizational skills, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Exceptional written and oral communication skills with the ability to convey complex or technical information clearly, concisely, and accurately to a wide range of audiences.
* Strong customer experience mindset with a passion for delivering exceptional service and improving customer outcomes.
* Proven experience in escalation management, customer success, customer experience, or customer care operations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex customer situations using a solution-oriented approach while balancing customer needs and business objectives.
* Ability to identify the root business need behind customer requests and provide practical, effective solutions.
* Strong interpersonal presence with the confidence and professionalism to challenge assumptions, manage difficult conversations, and push back on unrealistic expectations when appropriate.
* Excellent analytical and reporting skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.
* Experience leveraging reporting tools, dashboards, and AI-enabled solutions such as Microsoft Copilot to improve decision-making and operational effectiveness.
* Strong problem-solving skills with demonstrated success in root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Proven ability to drive cross-functional process improvements involving multiple stakeholders across departments.
* Experience leading change management initiatives, including stakeholder engagement, communication planning, implementation support, and outcome measurement.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present complex information clearly and professionally to a variety of audiences.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within global and cross-functional teams.
* Strong leadership capabilities with experience mentoring, coaching, developing, or influencing team members.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly: Excel (Pivot Tables, Charts, Data Analysis, Reporting) PowerPoint (Executive Presentations) SharePoint (Documentation and Knowledge Management)
* Experience working with customer experience metrics, performance reporting, and business reviews.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment and maintain a positive, flexible approach to daily work.

**Nice to Have**

  

* LEAN, ITIL, Agile, Six Sigma, or other process improvement certifications.
* Experience in clinical trials, life sciences, healthcare, pharmaceutical, or other regulated industries.
* Experience with Power BI for dashboard development and business analytics.
* Experience with Power Automate for workflow automation and operational efficiency improvements.
* Experience supporting global customers and international teams.
* Experience leading transformation, governance, or operational excellence initiatives.

The Department Head has the discretion to hire personnel with a combination of experience and education, which may vary from the above listed qualifications.

At Clario, we put people first, always. We are united and driven by patients, committed to making a difference, and we are always looking for the best talent to help us transform lives. We value the contribution each of our people brings. It’s only through our people that we can continue to innovate technology that will shape the future of clinical trials.

title: Engineer
description:
**Job title: Engineer - Aftermarket Sales**

**Location: Bangalore**

**About Us**

Ingersoll Rand is a Fortune 500 company with a passion for making lives better. We do this by living our values, and through a relentless focus on the success of our customers and partnering with our employees to think and act like owners. We believe in sustainability through the development and distribution of a broad range of global brands designed to meet the needs of our customers in both efficient and responsible ways. Ingersoll Rand is a diverse and inclusive environment. For more information visit: www.irco.com.

**Job Overview:**

The Aftermarket Sales Engineer for Power Tools and Industrial Lifting is responsible for maximizing lifecycle value of customer assets through preventive maintenance, OEM spare parts, repairs, refurbishment, modernization, and long-term service agreements. By leveraging Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) principles, the role helps customers improve safety, reliability, and productivity while reducing downtime and overall operating costs, thereby driving sustainable aftermarket growth and recurring revenue for the business.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Maintain a comprehensive database of installed power tools and industrial lifting equipment within the assigned territory.
* Build strong relationships with Customer manufacturing engineering, Production engineering , purchase, project and maintenance teams.
* Conduct regular customer visits to understand equipment utilization, maintenance practices, and operational challenges.
* Identify aftermarket opportunities across the entire equipment lifecycle.
* Promote preventive maintenance programs to increase equipment availability and reliability.
* Analyze equipment operating hours, service history, usage patterns, and failure trends.
* Recommend replacement of wear parts before failure occurs.
* Drive sales of preventive maintenance kits and scheduled replacement components.
* Convert inspection findings into spare parts and service orders.
* Educate customers on the financial benefits of planned maintenance versus breakdown repairs.
* Act as a trusted advisor by helping customers understand lifecycle costs associated with equipment ownership.
* Demonstrate how preventive maintenance can reduce:
* Unplanned downtime
* Emergency repair costs
* Production losses
* Overtime maintenance expenses
* Safety incidents
* Equipment replacement costs

**Develop business cases comparing:**

* Preventive maintenance vs. corrective maintenance
* OEM parts vs. non-genuine parts
* Repair vs. replacement decisions
* Planned shutdown maintenance vs. emergency breakdown repairs

**Position services and parts as tools to:**

* Extend asset life
* Reduce maintenance expenditure
* Enhance productivity
* Improve equipment availability
* Improve return on asset investment
* Conduct equipment condition assessments and site surveys.
* Perform health checks for lifting equipment and power tools.
* Identify worn-out or safety-critical components.
* Generate inspection reports with maintenance recommendations.
* Develop commercial proposals based on audit findings.
* Support customers in complying with safety and statutory inspection requirements.
* Identify opportunities for equipment refurbishment and rebuild projects.
* Promote overhaul programs to restore equipment performance.
* Recommend repair solutions based on equipment condition.
* Provide customers with cost-benefit analysis of repair versus replacement.
* Coordinate repair activities with service centers and field teams.

**Promote and secure:**

* Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
* Preventive Maintenance Agreements
* Inspection Contracts
* Calibration Services
* Repair and Overhaul Agreements

**Responsibilities include:**

* Contract renewals
* Contract profitability
* Multi-year service agreements
* Expansion of service coverage across customer sites
* Prepare technical and commercial quotations.
* Coordinate with service, operations, procurement, and supply chain teams.
* Ensure competitive pricing while maintaining profitability.
* Negotiate contracts and service agreements.
* Follow up quotations and improve order conversion rates.
* Monitor open opportunities through CRM systems.

**Achieve targets for:**

* Spare parts sales
* Service revenue
* Repair revenue
* AMC revenue
* Refurbishment projects
* Upgrade projects

* Improve aftermarket attachment rates.
* Increase recurring revenue through long-term service agreements.
* Manage profitability and gross margin performance.
* Drive sustainable growth within the installed base.

**Collaborate closely with:**

* Service Engineers
* Service Managers
* Product Specialists
* Supply Chain Teams
* Repair Centers
* Operations Teams
* Sales Teams
* Customer Maintenance Teams
* Map key customer assets and maintenance cycles.
* Develop account-specific aftermarket strategies.
* Identify high-revenue lifecycle opportunities.
* Track competitor activities and market trends.
* Position the company as a lifecycle reliability partner rather than simply a spare parts supplier.

**Requirements:**

* Qualitification can be BE in Mechatronics, Mechanical or Electrical, MBA an added advantage
* 5-7 years in handling customers

  

**Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements**

* 70-80% Travel (As and When required)

* Leave Encashments

* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
