---------------

The Client Success Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for managing a portfolio of Pismo clients predominantly in card issuing and ensuring they achieve their desired business outcomes from the Pismo platform. Acting as the primary day-to-day customer contact, the Analyst drives customer satisfaction, customer health, product adoption, revenue realization, and overall client success.

This role will be based in Bangalore, India.

The role combines customer relationship management, technical coordination, operational oversight, and business consulting. The Customer Success Analyst works independently to manage customer engagements while collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Commercial teams to deliver customer outcomes. For complex situations, strategic opportunities, and executive escalations, the Analyst will partner with Customer Success leaders and management.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically competent, commercially aware, and capable of building trusted relationships with both operational and management-level stakeholders within client organizations and Pismo.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Customer Ownership & Business Outcomes**

* Serve as the primary owner for an assigned portfolio of customer accounts.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business objectives, operating model, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes through effective use of Pismo's card issuing platform.
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across operational, technical, and management levels.
* Lead regular operational reviews and governance discussions with customers.
* Act as the customer's advocate within Pismo and ensure commitments are delivered.

### **Customer Health, Satisfaction & NPS**

* Own and continuously improve Customer Health Scores for assigned customers.
* Drive customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS) improvements through proactive engagement.
* Monitor customer sentiment, platform usage, service performance, and support trends to identify success opportunities and risks.
* Establish and execute action plans for customers showing signs of declining health.
* Drive proactive communication and follow-up to prevent escalations and strengthen customer confidence.

### **Revenue Realization & Growth**

* Ensure customers realize the value of their investment in the Pismo platform.
* Drive adoption of contracted products, features, and capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to increase platform utilization and business value.
* Support account planning activities by identifying expansion opportunities and revenue realization initiatives.
* Partner with Commercial and Account Management teams to contribute to revenue growth and retention objectives.

### **Technical Coordination & Issue Management**

* Develop strong knowledge of Pismo's card issuing platform, payment processing flows, APIs, product capabilities, and operational processes.
* Act as the coordination point between customers and internal Product, Engineering, SRE, Operations, and Support teams.
* Manage customer-reported issues through investigation, follow-up, communication, and resolution.
* Translate customer business requirements into actionable internal discussions.
* Ensure timely customer communication during incidents, enhancements, and platform changes.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Build productive relationships with customer operational teams, program managers, product owners, and business leaders.
* Engage confidently with middle-management stakeholders and participate in discussions with senior leadership when required.
* Coordinate effectively across multiple internal teams to drive customer outcomes.
* Escalate risks, opportunities, and customer concerns appropriately to Customer Success leadership.

### **Reporting & Insights**

* Monitor and analyze customer performance metrics, health indicators, and adoption trends.
* Prepare customer scorecards, operational reports, governance materials, and business reviews.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data-driven analysis.
* Provide recommendations to improve customer experience, adoption, and operational efficiency.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

The Customer Success Analyst will be accountable for:

* Customer Health Score improvement
* Net Promoter Score (NPS)
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* Revenue realization against contracted commitments
* Product adoption and engagement metrics
* Customer retention and renewal readiness
* Reduction in customer escalations
* Timely resolution and management of customer issues
* Delivery of customer success plans and agreed outcomes
* Positive customer and stakeholder feedback

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree
* 3-6 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Technical Account Management, Program Management, Payments Operations, Consulting, or related fields.
* Experience within payments, card issuing, fintech, banking, SaaS, or technology industries.

* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation
description:
Job Description

**Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation**

Company: Upstox

Location: Bengaluru

Work arrangement: 5 days in the office

Function: Insurance – B2B Sales (SDR / Lead Generation team)

**About Upstox**
----------------

At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and for everyone. We're one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We're not just moving fast — we’re moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high-energy, high-impact environment, you're in the right place.

**The Role: Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation**
-----------------------------------------------------

Upstox Insurance is building a B2B Employee Benefits (EB) business that helps corporates protect their employees through group insurance. As Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation, you’ll own the top of this funnel — building the lead management strategy, defining and building the list of target corporates, and leading a team of SDRs that consistently delivers the number and quality of leads the B2B sales team needs, month on month.

This is a player-coach role. Alongside managing the team, you’ll carry your own outreach target and personally call and engage decision-makers at target corporates. If you love building pipeline from scratch and leading from the front, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

**Lead Generation Strategy & Lead Management**

* **Lead management framework**: Design and own the end-to-end framework — sourcing, qualification criteria, lead scoring, handover to sales, follow-up cadences and recycling of cold leads.

* **Ideal customer profile**: Define the ICP by industry, employee strength, geography and current benefits set-up, and refine it based on conversion data.

* **Outreach playbooks**: Build multi-channel playbooks across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, referrals, partner channels and events.

* **Renewal-cycle planning**: Plan outreach around corporate policy renewal cycles so prospects are engaged well ahead of their group insurance renewal dates.

**Target Account List Building**

* **Target list**: Build, segment and continuously enrich a target list of suitable corporates, with mapped decision-makers across HR, Finance, Admin and leadership.

* **Research & data tools**: Use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and ZoomInfo to identify accounts and verify contact data.

* **Data hygiene & prioritisation**: Maintain data hygiene and prioritise accounts by size, fit and likelihood to convert.

**Pipeline Delivery to the Sales Team**

* **Qualified pipeline**: Ensure the B2B sales team receives the agreed number of qualified leads and meetings every month.

* **Monthly targets**: Agree monthly lead and meeting targets with B2B sales leadership, aligned to sales capacity and revenue goals.

* **Feedback loop**: Run a regular feedback loop with sales on lead quality and conversion, and adjust targeting, messaging and qualification accordingly.

**Team Leadership & Motivation**

* **Hiring & training**: Hire, onboard and train SDRs on prospecting, pitch, objection handling and Employee Benefits products (e.g., Group Health, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life).

* **Targets & reviews**: Set clear daily, weekly and monthly activity and outcome targets for each team member, and review progress through huddles and dashboards.

* **Coaching & culture**: Coach the team through call audits, role-plays and one-on-ones; drive a high-energy, performance-oriented culture.

**Individual Contribution**

* **Personal target**: Carry a personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set.

* **CXO outreach**: Personally call and engage senior decision-makers (CHROs, CFOs, founders) at priority and large accounts, and set up meetings for the sales team.

* **Lead from the front**: Take the lead on strategic accounts and new segments to build playbooks the team can replicate.

**Tools, Reporting & Analytics**

* **Lead management stack**: Own the CRM, dialers and sales engagement tools, and ensure full and disciplined adoption by the team.

* **Dashboards & MIS**: Build dashboards and share weekly and monthly MIS with the Business Head on activity, pipeline, conversion and target achievement.

* **Data-led allocation**: Use data to identify what is working by channel, segment and message, and reallocate team effort accordingly.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* **Collaboration**: Work with Marketing on campaigns, content and inbound lead flow; with Sales on smooth handovers; and with Product and Operations to bring market feedback back into the EB offering.

**How Success Is Measured**
---------------------------

* **Qualified leads delivered**: Sales-qualified leads / meetings handed over to the B2B sales team each month vs. target.

* **Meetings held**: Share of scheduled meetings that take place with the right decision-maker.

* **Funnel conversion**: Lead meeting proposal conversion rates, tracked by industry, company size and channel.

* **Team productivity**: Calls, connects, emails and LinkedIn touches per SDR per day/week.

* **Self-outreach target**: The Manager’s personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set.

* **Data quality**: Accuracy and completeness of the target account list and CRM records.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 5+ years of experience leading a B2B SDR / lead generation team, with a proven track record of delivering monthly pipeline targets.

* Strong understanding of lead management: ICP definition, list building, qualification frameworks, lead scoring and sales handover.

* Hands-on with lead management and sales engagement tools — CRM, dialers, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data platforms.

* Excellent cold calling and outreach skills, with the confidence to engage CXO and HR leadership directly.

* Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate and retain a high-performing team.

* Data-driven, with comfort in building and reading dashboards and MIS.

* Excellent communication skills.

* Willing to work on-site from Bengaluru.

**Good to have**

* Experience in insurance, Employee Benefits or group health, or B2B selling to HR and Finance teams (e.g., HR-tech, payroll, fintech, SaaS).

* Familiarity with insurance distribution and the IRDAI regulatory environment.

* Graduate degree; MBA preferred.

**Why This Role Rocks**
-----------------------

* You’ll build the top of the funnel for a brand-new B2B Employee Benefits business at one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms.

* You’ll have high ownership and visibility — your pipeline directly drives the revenue of the B2B insurance business.

* You’ll be a true player-coach, building a high-performing SDR team while leading from the front with CXOs.

* You’ll work with a passionate, fast-moving team across insurance, sales, marketing and product.

* Every corporate you bring in helps protect thousands of employees and their families.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our **Prospective Employee Privacy Notice**, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI"). I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice.

Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.

At Penguin Solutions (Nasdaq: PENG) – The AI Factory Platform Company – we’re building a team of innovators who thrive on collaboration, creativity, and the opportunity to help shape the future of AI. As part of the AI technology revolution, our teams design, build, deploy, and manage AI factories for enterprises, sovereign AI initiatives, and neocloud providers worldwide.

Headquartered in Silicon Valley, California, Penguin Solutions operates globally through a network of R&D, manufacturing, and sales locations. For nearly three decades, we have operated at the intersection of memory and AI/HPC infrastructure. That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale.

Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner solutions in a full-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision.

At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a **Manager, Quality Engineering** to lead quality engineering for ClusterWareAI, a critical component of the Penguin Solutions AI Factory Platform.

ClusterWareAI enables automated provisioning, orchestration, monitoring, and lifecycle management of large-scale AI infrastructure. In this role, you will define and drive the quality strategy for a complex distributed platform spanning GPU infrastructure, compute, networking, storage, Kubernetes, workload orchestration, and AI-enabled operations.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will lead and develop a Quality Engineering team while partnering closely with Software Engineering, Product Management, Platform Engineering, DevOps, Support, and Systems Integration teams to build quality into every stage of the product lifecycle.

The ideal candidate brings a strong product-engineering mindset, deep experience with test automation and distributed systems, and a passion for delivering reliable cloud and infrastructure software at scale.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end Quality Engineering strategy for ClusterWareAI across functional, integration, system, regression, performance, scalability, reliability, security, and resilience testing.
* Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing QE team while establishing strong technical, automation, and execution practices.
* Drive a shift-left, automation-first quality culture, partnering with Engineering, Product, Platform, DevOps, Support, and Systems Integration throughout the product lifecycle.
* Design scalable test automation frameworks across APIs, UI, CLI, control-plane services, infrastructure integrations, and end-to-end workflows, integrated with CI/CD quality gates.
* Define test strategies for GPU infrastructure, bare metal, Kubernetes, networking, storage, workload orchestration, and distributed systems at scale.
* Validate infrastructure lifecycle workflows including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, rollback, deprovisioning, monitoring, health management, and automated remediation.
* Drive performance, scalability, HA, fault-injection, longevity, and failure/recovery testing across large-scale distributed environments.
* Define validation for multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, security, access controls, resource governance, and workload separation.
* Establish quality and release-readiness metrics covering automation, escaped defects, test reliability, performance, scalability, and product risk.
* Partner with Support and Engineering on customer issues, root-cause analysis, and converting field failures into automated regression coverage.
* Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted quality engineering approaches to improve test generation, failure analysis, defect triage, and engineering productivity.

**AI / Agentic Quality Engineering**

* Own the AI Quality Engineering strategy for ClusterWareAI's AI Platform capabilities.
* Build automated AI evaluation frameworks and benchmark suites covering accuracy, groundedness, consistency, reliability, latency, cost, and task success.
* Establish LLM and agent evaluation methodologies using golden datasets, scenario-based testing, synthetic data, LLM-as-a-Judge, rubric-based evaluation, and human evaluation.
* Test RAG, tool calling, multi-step agents, planning/execution, agent collaboration, memory, and infrastructure-aware reasoning.
* Develop AI regression pipelines to detect degradation caused by changes to models, prompts, agents, tools, knowledge sources, and orchestration logic.
* Drive AI safety and adversarial testing, including hallucination, prompt injection, unauthorized tool use, policy violations, data leakage, and unsafe infrastructure actions.
* Validate agent guardrails, policy enforcement, approvals, authorization boundaries, tenant isolation, auditability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Establish production AI quality metrics including task success rate, hallucination rate, tool-call accuracy, agent failure rate, escalation rate, latency, and cost efficiency.
* Develop scenario-based autonomous infrastructure testing to validate that agents correctly observe, reason, plan, obtain approval, execute authorized actions, verify outcomes, and recover safely from failures.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 12+ years in Quality Engineering, Software Engineering, Test Automation, or related engineering roles, with 3+ years leading QE teams.
* Proven experience owning quality for a commercial software, cloud, infrastructure, or distributed systems platform.
* Strong programming and automation skills, preferably Python, with experience building scalable automation frameworks.
* Strong experience testing APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, infrastructure software, and complex enterprise applications.
* Experience with CI/CD, performance, scalability, reliability, HA, security, and failure/recovery testing.
* Strong Linux, debugging, observability, log analysis, and distributed-systems troubleshooting skills.
* Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, coaching, and team development.
* Hands-on experience with AI/LLM quality engineering, AI evaluation, or testing AI-powered applications.
* Experience testing LLM applications, RAG, AI agents, multi-agent systems, or agentic workflows.
* Experience with AI evaluation methodologies including golden datasets, benchmark testing, LLM-as-a-Judge, RAG evaluation, adversarial testing, and red teaming.
* Experience with frameworks such as DeepEval, Ragas, Promptfoo, LangSmith/LangChain evaluation, NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails, or equivalent.
* Understanding of AI failure modes including hallucination, prompt injection, non-determinism, tool-use errors, context failures, model regression, and unsafe agent behavior.
* Experience integrating AI evaluation and regression testing into CI/CD pipelines.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AI infrastructure, GPU cloud/neocloud platforms, or large-scale cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, and multi-tenant cloud platforms.
* Experience with GPU infrastructure, including GPU lifecycle, drivers, firmware, health monitoring, and heterogeneous accelerator environments.

title: Senior Implementation Engineer I
description:
**Senior Implementation Engineer I**

**Department:** Professional Services

**Level:** IC – Mid-Level

**Location:** Bangalore

**Type:** Full-Time

**Reports To:** Tech Manager

  

**About Cleo**

Cleo is the AI-native supply chain orchestration company built on modern EDI. We help businesses orchestrate EDI, API, MFT, applications, and trading partner ecosystems with the visibility, intelligence, and control needed to keep business-critical supply chain transactions moving — from order to cash, procure to pay, and everywhere in between.

Our platform, Cleo Integration Cloud, brings together integration, workflow automation, real-time monitoring, and Agentic AI intelligence so supply chain, operations, and IT teams can launch partners faster, automate transactions across business systems, resolve exceptions before they become disruptions, and gain actionable insight across the end-to-end supply chain.

Trusted by 5,000+ customers across manufacturing, retail, logistics, and distribution, Cleo is headquartered in Rockford, Illinois, with offices in Chicago and Bangalore. We are a team united by one mission: to make supply chains smarter. Cleo Never Stops.

  

**The Opportunity**

* Understand customer requirements and propose solutions by SA.
* Own end-to-end EDI and integration implementations for enterprise customers.
* Configure integrations, support UAT, and build expertise toward Solution Architect roles.

  

**What You'll Do**

* Configure EDI, API, and communication protocols (AS2, SFTP, VAN).
* Build, test, and troubleshoot business processes, ERP integrations, and data mappings.
* Implement REST/SOAP APIs with OAuth and security controls.
* Support customer workshops, UAT, and issue resolution.
* Apply performance, security, and implementation best practices.

  

**What You Bring**

**Required**

* B.E./B.Tech with 2–4 years of EDI, B2B integration, or middleware experience.
* Knowledge of ANSI X12, EDIFACT, AS2, SFTP, APIs, and ERP integrations (SAP preferred).
* Experience with BPS, data mapping, REST/SOAP APIs, OAuth, and UAT.
* Strong troubleshooting and customer-facing implementation skills.
* Supply chain domain, legacy B2B tools, or AI tool experience is a plus.

**Preferred**

* Experience with supply chain domains: retail, grocery, 3PL/logistics, or manufacturing
* Prior exposure to legacy B2B tools (Sterling, Gentran, OpenText) — helpful for migration projects
* Familiarity with AI tools for documentation, analysis, or delivery acceleration

  

**Behavior Competencies**

**Level 2: Initiative -**Takes initiatives within their area of responsibility to accelerate finding solutions. Detects problems, escalates with proposed solutions.

  

**Leadership & Management -**Ability to work within or lead a team

**Planning & Organization-** Ability to manage tasks and activities

**Level 2: Scheduling-** Determines a course of action by breaking it into smaller steps, planning and resourcing each, and adjusting for potential problems.

  

**Customer Focus-** Ability to manage relationships with customers

**Level 2: Customer Oriented-** Understands the needs of external customers and keeps them in mind when taking actions or making decisions.

  

**Interpersonal Communication-** Ability to communicate effectively with people

**Level 2: Active Listening & Empathy-** Listens to others' points of view through verbal and non-verbal communication. Formulates own views while understanding others'.

  

**Achievement Focus-** Ability to achieve objectives

**Level 2: Persistence-** Meets targets and fulfills agreements even when adverse circumstances prevail. Stays focused and resourceful under pressure.

  

**Solution Finding-** Ability to analyze situations and find accurate solutions

**Level 2: Information Acquisition-** Identifies gaps in available information and provides solutions for fixing them. Takes new information into account and modifies understanding accordingly.

  

**People Focus-** Ability to account for the human factor

**Level 2: Efficiency of Staff-** Manages own stress and avoids impacting team members. Anticipates and manages potential conflicts. Champions diversity through a positive approach.

  

**AI Fluency**

Uses AI to accelerate project delivery — drafting implementation plans, summarizing customer requirements, and generating documentation faster. Can point to specific examples where AI improved turnaround time or output quality on a customer engagement.

Familiar with basic AI terms and terminologies. Ability to use org level AI tools , writes basic prompts effectively. Validates outputs before use. Participates in team feedback loops.

  

**Why Cleo**

**Join. Grow. Lead the Future of Supply Chain.**

At Cleo we don't just manage supply chains — we orchestrate them. You'll be empowered to drive transformation, deliver excellence, and shape the future of global operations. Whether you're joining us from outside or growing within, this is your platform to lead with purpose, innovate with impact, and thrive in a culture that champions your growth.

  

**WHY JOIN US**

**Strategic Influence**

Be at the helm of global supply chain strategy, driving decisions that impact customers, partners, and communities worldwide.

**Innovation-Driven Culture**

Work with the latest in AI, automation, and digital supply chain platforms to solve complex challenges.

**End-to-End Visibility**

Lead across planning, sourcing, logistics, and fulfillment — connecting dots others can't see.

**Sustainability at the Core**

Help build ethical, transparent, and sustainable supply chains that make a difference.

  

**WHY GROW WITH US**

Access world-class programs, executive mentorship, and rotational opportunities to accelerate your career.

**Internal Mobility**

We prioritize internal talent — your next big opportunity could be just one conversation away.

**Recognition & Impact**

Your ideas matter.Your leadership is visible. Your success is celebrated.

**Inclusive Community**

Thrive in a diverse, collaborative environment where every voice is heard and respected.

  

We are a Talent Destination for supply chain leaders who want to make bold moves, solve real world problems, and grow without limits. Whether you're stepping into your first leadership role or scaling new heights — your journey starts here. Cleo Never Stops.

Willingness to travel minimum 50% of the time.

Appobile Labs Pvt Ltd is an Information Technology company founded in May 2010, focused on delivering innovative and efficient B2B technology solutions. The company specializes in digital transformation and enhancing business processes with its advanced software platforms, helping companies and their teams excel. Appobile Labs has developed two flagship products—SalesDiary, an AI-powered sales application, and emmlyt, a comprehensive mobile device management solution for enterprises. We are looking for a Customer Success / Account Manager to manage post-sales relationships with enterprise customers using Salesdiary.

This role is not basic support. You will be responsible for customer onboarding, product adoption, account health, escalations, business reviews, requirement documentation, and coordination with internal Product, Engineering, Support, Implementation, and Sales teams.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable speaking with customer SPOCs, operations teams, IT teams, and internal technical teams. You should be able to understand business workflows, read usage data, document requirements clearly, and drive structured follow-ups.

title: Senior Associate - Customer Operations
description:
Laundryheap is a UK-headquartered tech platform delivering on-demand laundry within 24 hours. Founded in 2014, we now serve 17+ global markets across the UK, US, UAE, and beyond. We are expanding rapidly across Europe, Asia, and North America—and we're hiring passionate talent to power our next phase of growth.

We are looking for an energetic and detail-oriented individual to work for us in our overseas office (Bengaluru, India). As we are an international brand working across different time zones, we require the potential candidate to be flexible to work in shift patterns (mostly nights).

**You'll Make a Difference By:**

Reporting to the Associate Lead, you will join our **Linen Operations team**; **Laundryheap Linen is a B2B linen rental and commercial cleaning solution within Laundryheap, designed specifically for short-stay hosts and property managers.** The Linen team runs daily operations through two dedicated functions: Driver Operations and Customer Operations, each split across a morning and a night shift. You will own the Customer Operations function — accountable for how it performs, the standards it runs to, and the processes behind it — while overseeing its shifts day to day as the first point of contact for our business customers: resolving issues on live chat, managing their orders end to end, and making sure the promise we made is the one we deliver.

You will support and work alongside the Driver Operations team, who monitor driver activity, keep routes on track, and step in when something goes wrong on the road. The two sides feed each other — the better you understand what is happening on the ground, the better the answer you can give the client.

**Key Responsibilities**

Ownership & Performance

* Own the Customer Operations function end to end — accountable for its performance, standards and processes across both shifts.
* Own the KPI and SLA metrics for Customer Operations top to bottom: define what gets measured, track it live, report on it, and answer for it.
* Oversee the running of both shifts — set priorities, make the call on escalations, and act as the senior point of reference for the team on duty.
* Monitor performance against targets in real time, spot gaps as they form, and intervene before the client feels them.
* Produce the end-of-shift report — volumes, SLA breaches, complaint themes, root causes, and actions taken.
* Hand over cleanly to the incoming shift, with open issues, risks and context documented so nothing is lost between shifts.

Process Ownership & Standards

* Create, document and own the SOPs for Customer Operations — response targets, SLA matrix, escalation thresholds and situation playbooks.
* Define the rules the shift runs by: client prioritisation, when a last-minute request can be accommodated, and when something must be escalated.
* Treat every recurring failure as a process problem — review it, change the process, and confirm the change worked.
* Build and maintain the knowledge base so the shift runs on documented practice rather than on any one person's memory.
* Identify tooling and automation opportunities, build the case, and see the change through to adoption.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Act as the Customer Operations voice with Driver Operations, warehouse, fleet, inventory and accounts.
* Represent the client perspective in the daily operations call, and escalate issues that need a fix beyond your shift.
* Work with the Driver Operations senior member to resolve conflicts between client commitments and operational capacity, using agreed thresholds rather than case-by-case debate.
* Partner with account managers on client feedback, service reviews and account-specific requirements.

Team Leadership & Development

* Lead improvement projects from problem definition through to a measured outcome.
* Be the person the team turns to when the answer is not in the SOP.
* Onboard and train new members joining your shift, and sign off their competency.
* Review client conversations for quality and coach the team on tone, accuracy and escalation judgement.
* Deputise for the Associate Lead where required.

Customer Communication & Resolution (B2B)

* Respond accurately and promptly across all communication channels, including live chat, to the first response and resolution targets set for the team.
* Own escalated conversations end-to-end, maintaining contact with the customer until the issue is genuinely closed.
* Ensure high standards of tone and language in all written and verbal communications to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Liaise with all stakeholders — warehouse, fleet, inventory, and accounts — to resolve customer complaints in the most efficient and effective manner, referring issues using the correct escalation procedures.
* Act as an ambassador for Laundryheap Linen, using knowledge of the organisation and our offerings to promote Laundryheap positively at any given opportunity.

Order & Account Management

* Receive, review, and process customer orders accurately, verifying quantities, addresses, timeslots, and any account-specific requirements.
* Handle amendments, cancellations, and last-minute requests, balancing what the client needs against what the operation can deliver.
* Create and manage cleaning service orders using internal tools, ensuring end-to-end fulfillment and proactive resolution of operational issues.
* Facilitate smooth onboarding for new clients by addressing live queries and closely monitoring their initial orders to ensure a seamless first-order experience.
* Work closely with account managers to ensure the customer's needs are exceeded and feedback is communicated to all stakeholders.

Operations & Continuous Improvement

* Track KPIs and flag performance bottlenecks, ensuring SLA adherence.
* Maintain internal documentation and knowledge bases.
* Contribute to team goals by initiating or supporting projects aimed at improving operational workflows.
* Collaborate with internal teams across the UK for smooth operations.

* Flexibility — last-minute client requests accommodated without disrupting the wider plan.

**Minimum Skills Required**

* Relevant years of experience should be between 2–5 years, including 2+ years in customer service and escalation management (chat/email).

* Experienced in the investigation of quick resolution and escalation.

* Experience in night shifts / rotational shifts.

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* Former experience in a tech start-up.
* Experience of working in a fast-paced, customer service environment.

* Analytical with an understanding of and passion for data-driven decisions, and comfort with operational data.
* Able to continually seek improved ways of working.
* Speed, flexibility, and agility; ability to work independently in a rapidly changing environment.

**Work Schedule and Patterns**

* 9-hour shift (8 working hours + 1-hour break).
* 5 days a week, including nights and weekends (2 rotational week-offs based on rota).
* Shifts are anchored to UK time.
* Office-based role.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work in a collaborative environment where your ideas are heard and valued.
* Gain exposure to international markets and complex customer operations.

We love to work with ambitious, proactive people who have a can-do attitude and are confident decision-makers. So, if this sounds like you, take this opportunity and apply to join the International Laundryheap Team today!

Job Title: Service Desk Operations & Governance SME  
Position: Associate Consultant
  
Experience: 6+ Years  
Category: Software Development/ Engineering  
Main location: Bangalore  
Job Code: J0826-2154  
Employment Type: Full Time  
  
Job Description:
  
  
We are looking for a seasoned Service Desk professional with strong operational and ITIL expertise to take ownership of the day-to-day operational governance of a multilingual Service Desk environment.  
The role will be responsible for ensuring that Service Desk operations are structured, measurable, governed and continuously improved. The individual will analyse operational performance, identify recurring issues and service gaps, drive corrective actions, ensure adherence to agreed processes and coordinate with L2/L3 teams to improve resolution outcomes.  
The role is not limited to managing people or monitoring queues. The successful candidate will act as a Service Desk subject-matter expert and operational governance owner, bringing structure, discipline and analytical insight into the operation.  
The role will work closely with the Service Delivery Manager, Service Desk Leads, L2/L3 resolver teams, application teams, infrastructure teams, workplace/EUS teams, vendors and client stakeholders.  
Key Responsibilities:  
  
1. Service Desk Operational Governance  

* Own the day-to-day operational governance of the Service Desk.
* Establish and maintain operational routines covering:

o Daily operational review  
o SLA performance  
o Backlog  
o Aging tickets  
o Priority incidents  
o Reassignments  
o Escalations  
o Abandoned/unanswered calls  
o Ticket quality  
o Customer feedback  

* Ensure operational teams follow agreed processes, SOPs and ITIL practices.
* Identify deviations from the operating model and drive corrective actions.
* Ensure appropriate ownership and accountability across the Service Desk.
* Maintain operational readiness for changes, new services and project transitions.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
2. Performance & Data Analysis  
This should be one of the core responsibilities of the role.  

* Analyse Service Desk performance trends and identify underlying causes.
* Monitor and interpret:

o SLA achievement  
o Response and resolution performance  
o Ticket volumes  
o Backlog  
o Aging  
o Reopen rates  
o First Contact Resolution  
o Escalation rates  
o Call abandonment  
o Customer satisfaction  
o Productivity  
o Quality scores  

* Identify trends rather than simply reporting numbers.
* Produce meaningful operational insights and recommendations.
* Identify recurring operational issues and translate them into improvement initiatives.
* Maintain dashboards and management reports.
* Prepare inputs for weekly/monthly service reviews.
* Highlight risks and emerging issues to the SDM before they become escalations.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
3. Ticket Hygiene & Quality Management  

* Drive improvement in Service Desk ticket quality and documentation.
* Ensure tickets contain appropriate:

o Categorisation  
o Prioritisation  
o User/business impact  
o Troubleshooting performed  
o Worklogs  
o Resolution details  
o Knowledge references  
o Closure information  

* Perform regular ticket sampling and quality audits.
* Identify recurring quality issues by agent/team/process.
* Work with Team Leads to implement corrective actions.
* Ensure tickets are progressed appropriately and do not remain unnecessarily in queues.
* Identify tickets requiring escalation and ensure timely handover to L2/L3.
* Monitor tickets approaching SLA breach and ensure proactive intervention.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
4. Incident, Problem & Escalation Management  

* Provide operational oversight of Major/P1/P2 incidents from the Service Desk perspective.
* Ensure correct prioritisation and escalation based on business impact.
* Support Major Incident Management and ensure appropriate Service Desk participation.
* Identify recurring incidents and candidates for Problem Management.
* Analyse repeat incidents and identify opportunities for permanent resolution.
* Work with L2/L3 resolver groups to drive recurring-problem reduction.
* Track outstanding actions from major incidents and problem investigations.
* Ensure lessons learned are converted into process, knowledge or technical improvements.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
5. Cross-Functional Coordination  
Act as the operational bridge between Service Desk and resolver teams.  

* Coordinate with L2/L3 Infrastructure, Applications, EUS, IAM, Network, Cloud and other support teams.
* Identify bottlenecks in the incident/request resolution lifecycle.
* Challenge unnecessary ticket transfers and ownership gaps.
* Ensure clear escalation paths are followed.
* Drive resolution of aged or stuck tickets across resolver groups.
* Identify recurring dependency issues between Service Desk and other support towers.
* Work with application and infrastructure SMEs to improve knowledge available to the Service Desk.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
6. Process & Continual Service Improvement  

* Identify opportunities to streamline Service Desk processes.
* Review existing workflows and identify unnecessary manual steps.
* Drive continual improvement initiatives around:

o Incident management  
o Request fulfilment  
o Knowledge management  
o Escalation  
o Ticket routing  
o Categorisation  
o Automation  
o Self-service  
o Monitoring integration  

* Identify opportunities for automation and shift-left.
* Improve First Contact Resolution through better knowledge, tooling and training.
* Maintain and improve Service Desk SOPs and operational documentation.
* Support implementation of ITIL-aligned practices.
* Ensure improvements are measurable and demonstrate operational/business benefit.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
7. Knowledge Management  

* Ensure knowledge articles are available and usable by Service Desk agents.
* Identify knowledge gaps from ticket trends and recurring incidents.
* Work with L2/L3 teams to convert technical resolutions into Service Desk knowledge.
* Review the quality and usefulness of existing knowledge articles.
* Drive adoption of Knowledge Management and shift-left practices.
* Identify opportunities for self-service and automation based on recurring requests.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
8. Team Coaching & Operational Enablement  
The role should not replace the Team Leads, but should provide SME-level direction and coaching.  

* Coach Team Leads and senior analysts on ITIL processes and operational practices.
* Support agents in improving troubleshooting and ticket-handling quality.
* Identify capability gaps based on operational data.
* Recommend targeted training and coaching.
* Conduct periodic knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Support onboarding of new Service Desk resources.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
9. Client & Stakeholder Support  
The person will have stakeholder interaction, but the SDM remains the primary client/account owner.  

* Provide operational inputs for client service reviews.
* Prepare factual analysis and recommendations for the SDM.
* Participate in operational governance meetings.
* Support service-related escalations.
* Provide timely updates on operational risks and improvement actions.
* Translate operational data into meaningful business-level insights.
* Support the SDM in preparing service improvement proposals and operational roadmaps.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
10. Governance & Compliance  

* Ensure adherence to agreed governance frameworks and contractual processes.
* Maintain operational evidence required for audits and governance reviews.
* Ensure compliance with ITIL, security and organisational processes.
* Track actions, risks, issues and improvement initiatives.
* Maintain Service Desk operational documentation and control mechanisms.
* Support internal and client audits where required.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
11. Key Deliverables / KPIs  
I would make the role accountable for outcomes, rather than just activities.  
Area Expected Outcome  
SLA Consistent SLA achievement and early intervention on breaches  
Backlog Controlled and continuously improving backlog  
Ticket Aging Reduction of aged/stagnant tickets  
Ticket Quality Improved ticket hygiene and documentation  
FCR Continuous improvement in First Contact Resolution  
CSAT Improvement in customer experience  
Escalations Reduction in avoidable escalations  
Repeat Incidents Identification and reduction of recurring issues  
Quality Consistent quality audit performance  
Process Compliance High adherence to agreed ITIL processes  
Knowledge Increased usage and quality of knowledge articles  
Automation Identification and delivery of automation opportunities  
Continual Improvement Measurable improvement initiatives delivered  
Governance Accurate and timely operational reporting  
  
Mandatory Skills:  

* 6+ years of Service Desk / IT Operations experience, with significant experience in senior/SME/leadership roles.
* Strong experience managing large or complex Service Desk operations.
* Strong understanding of ITIL Incident, Request, Problem, Change and Knowledge Management.
* Experience with SLA/KPI management and operational governance.
* Strong analytical and reporting skills.
* Demonstrated experience in root-cause analysis and recurring-issue reduction.
* Strong understanding of Service Desk ticket lifecycle and ITSM practices.
* Experience working with L2/L3 resolver teams.
* Experience managing operational escalations.
* Experience in continual service improvement.
* Strong stakeholder communication skills.
* Experience working in a multi-team / multi-vendor IT environment.

Preferred Skills :
  

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* ITIL Managing Professional modules would be an advantage.
* Experience with TopDesk, ServiceNow, BMC Remedy or similar ITSM platforms.
* Experience with multilingual Service Desk operations.
* Experience with Service Desk transformation, automation and shift-left initiatives.
* Experience with Microsoft technologies / Workplace / EUS environments.
* Experience in outsourced IT service delivery / managed services

ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales & Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.

description:
Bangalore, India Category Digital(IT) Posted Date 08/24/2026 Job Id 365616

Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.

  
  

At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.

  
  

Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.

  
  

**More about the role**

  
  

**Job Summary**

The Regional (Site IT / Hub) Lead is responsible for leading and coordinating user support services within a defined / assigned region. This role ensures that employees receive timely, professional, and effective IT support for workplace technology, including laptops, mobile devices, collaboration tools, business applications, and office IT services. The Team Lead acts as the first point of escalation for support issues, manages the day-to-day performance of the regional support team, and works closely with global teams of infrastructure and security. In addition, collaborates with business stakeholders to deliver a consistent and high-quality support experience. The Regional Site IT Lead is responsible for and will oversee local Field Service Support engineers, Digital Technical Engineers and Service desk agents in a specific DigITal Hub location, and oversee field support for all sites assigned in the region

The Regional Site IT Lead is focused on helping end users to make better use of IT solutions. This will lead to improved productivity as well as improved customer satisfaction.

Key Areas of Responsibility

**1. Team Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and support a regional team of Technical Engineers, Site IT Leads and Service desk agents.
* Coordinate daily support activities, workloads, priorities, and shift coverage across the region (s).
* Provide guidance on complex incidents, service requests, escalations,
* Support team development through mentoring, feedback, knowledge sharing, and performance input.
* Promote a customer-focused, professional, and service-oriented team culture.

<>·

**2. End user support delivery**

* Ensure high-quality support for end user devices, operating systems, productivity tools, collaboration platforms, printers, peripherals, Fixed and mobile telephony, and standard business applications.
* Oversee incident and service request handling in line with agreed service levels.
* Monitor ticket queues to ensure timely resolution, proper prioritization, and accurate documentation.
* Act as an escalation point for unresolved or high-impact support issues.
* Support onboarding, offboarding, device deployment, asset replacement, and office moves.
* Ensure the regional IT Service desks executes issues and requests in line with expectations, and in accordance to the Global Service desk owner.
* Daily management of activities with the team

**3. Regional IT Operations**

* Coordinate local and regional IT support activities across offices, sites, or countries within the assigned region.
* Ensure regional support processes operate with global IT standards, policies, and procedures.
* Partner with global teams to support infrastructure, network, security, IAM and application-related activities.
* Act as regional hub lead for other teams within the same region of hub
* Assist with regional rollouts, technology refreshes, software deployments, and change initiatives.
* Maintain awareness of regional business needs, local constraints, and service improvement opportunities.

**4. Asset, Compliance & security**

* Ensure accurate management of IT assets, including laptops, mobile devices, accessories, and peripherals.
* Support hardware lifecycle activities, inventory controls, forecasting, disposals. and audit requirements in alignment with Global Hardware Asset Manager.
* Ensure end user support activities follow company security policies and compliance standards.
* Promote secure working practices, including device encryption, access control, patching, and data protection.
* Escalate security incidents or policy breaches through the appropriate channels.

<>·

**5. Service coordinator**

* Manage relationships with managed (security) service providers.
* Acts as local host in global projects, roll-outs & adaptive change requests.
* Provide insight in impact that global initiatives have on local business.
* Monitor all IT incidents & requests escalated by users in the local domain.
* Work with the respective Service Owners and collaborate with the partners to ensure proper follow-up.
* Facilitate contact points for all supporting activities for vendors to perform services onsite when needed
* Track support performance, recurring issues, service trends, and user feedback.
* Contribute to knowledge base articles, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
* Ensure incidents, requests, changes, and problems are handled according to ITIL-aligned practices.
* Support root cause analysis and problem management for recurring end user issues.

**6. Continuous improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve support processes, documentation, automation, and user experience.
* Identify problems & channel towards the relevant Service Owner. Support the problem analysis.
* Monitors local customer satisfaction and engages within DigITal on root cause & the improvements.
* Contribute to continuous improvement and standardization of DigITal processes and services.
* Share and drive best practices.

Critical Experiences

**Leadership Expectations**

The Regional (Site IT / Hub) Lead is expected to:

* Customer focus and service excellence.
* Team leadership and coaching.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Clear communication and stakeholder engagement.
* Ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work across cultures, time zones, and regional teams.
* Continuous improvement mindset.
* Understands the regional dimensions
* Stakeholder satisfaction & management

**Your Profile**

title: Customer Success Manager - Growth
description:
**About Easyship**

Easyship is one of the world's leading multi-carrier shipping software, built to make global eCommerce borderless. Since 2014, we've been on a mission to democratize logistics by removing the "black box" of international shipping costs and complexities. Trusted by over 100,000 brands, our platform provides a single "mission control" for global trade, offering access to 550+ courier services across 200+ destinations.

We are an award-winning, global team (Forbes 30 Under 30, TechInAsia's Best Startup) with offices in London, New York, Hong Kong, and beyond. We're growing fast, we value transparency, and we genuinely enjoy building the infrastructure that powers modern commerce. If you're ready to solve complex problems at scale, we'd love to have you join us.

**Who We're Looking For**

This is a new role at Easyship. As our Growth Customer Success Manager, you'll own the relationship with a portfolio of around 100 customers, ranging from merchants who ship entirely through our dashboard to teams building on our API. You'll help them get the most out of Easyship, resolve their technical questions directly, and lead upsells and renewals across your portfolio.

We're looking for someone technically strong and largely self-sufficient, who combines SaaS, AI, data and API skills with the relationship and commercial instincts of an experienced CSM. You'll be comfortable moving from a webhook question in the morning to a renewal conversation in the afternoon, and you'll use AI tools and agents to automate repetitive work so you can spend more time with customers .You'll join our Customer Success team within Client Services, reporting to the Director of Client Services, and working closely with High Touch CSMs, CSM Operations & Enablement, Customer Support, Implementation Services, Sales, Marketing, Operations, Product, Engineering and Finance.

**This is a full-time role based onsite in Bengaluru, 5 days a week. Working hours are flexible, broadly 12:00 PM–9:00 PM IST, so you can support customers across EMEA, APAC and North America.**

**What You'll Be Responsible For**

* Own a portfolio of around 100 customers from onboarding onwards, with a clear success plan for each.
* Onboard customers onto the Easyship dashboard, from store integrations and couriers to shipping rules and first live shipments.
* Drive adoption of the dashboard and API, guiding customers to use each where it best serves their workflow.
* Resolve technical questions directly, from dashboard setup to APIs, webhooks and integrations, escalating only where required.
* Monitor account health through shipment volume, Health Score, NPS and CSAT, and act early on churn risk.
* Identify and lead upsell conversations, such as shipping insurance and eFulfilment, and secure renewals.
* Run regular check-ins and business reviews that show customers the value they're getting.
* Build AI-assisted workflows and agents to automate repeat work, such as account research, health monitoring and customer communications.
* Present webinars and write customer-facing content, documentation and guides, including helping customers connect their AI assistants to Easyship through our MCP capabilities.
* Feed customer feedback and product gaps to Product, and secure success stories, ratings and referrals.

**You Might Be a Good Fit If…**

* You have 3+ years in technical support or customer success, and 5+ years in customer-facing roles, with a record of driving adoption, retention and revenue growth.
* You have hands-on command of REST APIs, webhooks and API authentication (OAuth 2.0, API keys).
* You use AI tools confidently, including building AI-assisted workflows and analysing data with tools such as Claude and BigQuery.
* You've managed a large portfolio of accounts at once and led upsell and renewal conversations.
* You have strong business acumen and can tie value to each customer's goals and KPIs.
* You learn SaaS platforms quickly and become the go-to expert in them.
* You can explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, and you're confident presenting webinars and writing customer-facing content.
* You have excellent written and verbal English and strong data storytelling skills.
* You're comfortable working independently in a new role, without close supervision.
* Nice to have: logistics, eCommerce or eFulfilment experience; SQL, Postman, Python or JavaScript; familiarity with MCP; experience with Shopify, HubSpot or Zendesk.

*If you're excited about this role but don't meet every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.*

**What We Bring to the Table as an Employer**

* Generous remuneration and stock units
* Comprehensive health coverage
* We reimburse gym and wellness expenses so you can invest in your health
* Zomato digital meal credits and a pantry full of wholesome snacks to keep you fuelled through the workday
* The freedom to 'Work from Anywhere' for 4 weeks in a year
* Generous vacation policy, plus duvet days and mental health days to truly recharge

**How we value inclusion in our recruitment practices**

Easyship is an equal opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions — recruiting, hiring, pay, benefits, training, promotion, leave, and separation — based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, veteran or military status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Headquartered in London with offices in New York, Hong Kong, Bangalore, Singapore, Melbourne, Toronto, and Taipei – our team is global and growing. We encourage you to apply if a challenge excites you. Come and join the Easyship team!

title: Analyst, Client Success
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Client Success Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for managing a portfolio of Pismo clients predominantly in card issuing and ensuring they achieve their desired business outcomes from the Pismo platform. Acting as the primary day-to-day customer contact, the Analyst drives customer satisfaction, customer health, product adoption, revenue realization, and overall client success.

This role will be based in Bangalore, India.

The role combines customer relationship management, technical coordination, operational oversight, and business consulting. The Customer Success Analyst works independently to manage customer engagements while collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Commercial teams to deliver customer outcomes. For complex situations, strategic opportunities, and executive escalations, the Analyst will partner with Customer Success leaders and management.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically competent, commercially aware, and capable of building trusted relationships with both operational and management-level stakeholders within client organizations and Pismo.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Customer Ownership & Business Outcomes**

* Serve as the primary owner for an assigned portfolio of customer accounts.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business objectives, operating model, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes through effective use of Pismo's card issuing platform.
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across operational, technical, and management levels.
* Lead regular operational reviews and governance discussions with customers.
* Act as the customer's advocate within Pismo and ensure commitments are delivered.

### **Customer Health, Satisfaction & NPS**

* Own and continuously improve Customer Health Scores for assigned customers.
* Drive customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS) improvements through proactive engagement.
* Monitor customer sentiment, platform usage, service performance, and support trends to identify success opportunities and risks.
* Establish and execute action plans for customers showing signs of declining health.
* Drive proactive communication and follow-up to prevent escalations and strengthen customer confidence.

### **Revenue Realization & Growth**

* Ensure customers realize the value of their investment in the Pismo platform.
* Drive adoption of contracted products, features, and capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to increase platform utilization and business value.
* Support account planning activities by identifying expansion opportunities and revenue realization initiatives.
* Partner with Commercial and Account Management teams to contribute to revenue growth and retention objectives.

### **Technical Coordination & Issue Management**

* Develop strong knowledge of Pismo's card issuing platform, payment processing flows, APIs, product capabilities, and operational processes.
* Act as the coordination point between customers and internal Product, Engineering, SRE, Operations, and Support teams.
* Manage customer-reported issues through investigation, follow-up, communication, and resolution.
* Translate customer business requirements into actionable internal discussions.
* Ensure timely customer communication during incidents, enhancements, and platform changes.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Build productive relationships with customer operational teams, program managers, product owners, and business leaders.
* Engage confidently with middle-management stakeholders and participate in discussions with senior leadership when required.
* Coordinate effectively across multiple internal teams to drive customer outcomes.
* Escalate risks, opportunities, and customer concerns appropriately to Customer Success leadership.

### **Reporting & Insights**

* Monitor and analyze customer performance metrics, health indicators, and adoption trends.
* Prepare customer scorecards, operational reports, governance materials, and business reviews.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data-driven analysis.
* Provide recommendations to improve customer experience, adoption, and operational efficiency.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

The Customer Success Analyst will be accountable for:

* Customer Health Score improvement
* Net Promoter Score (NPS)
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* Revenue realization against contracted commitments
* Product adoption and engagement metrics
* Customer retention and renewal readiness
* Reduction in customer escalations
* Timely resolution and management of customer issues
* Delivery of customer success plans and agreed outcomes
* Positive customer and stakeholder feedback

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree
* 3-6 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Technical Account Management, Program Management, Payments Operations, Consulting, or related fields.
* Experience within payments, card issuing, fintech, banking, SaaS, or technology industries.
* Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management and customer success principles.
* Ability to independently manage customer relationships and workstreams.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage competing priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of card issuing, authorization processing, disputes, settlement, digital wallets, and payment network ecosystems.
* Experience working with API-based platforms and modern cloud technologies.
* Familiarity with Visa and Mastercard issuing environments.
* Experience managing customer health programs, adoption tracking, and business reviews.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

description:

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1751744

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**Associate Director, Strategy & Execution, Consumer Products and Retail, EY-Parthenon GDS India**

At EY, we develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We empower you in a flexible environment and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.

We work together across our full spectrum of services and skills, powered by technology and AI, so that business, people and the planet can thrive together.

We’re all in, are you?

Join EY and shape your future with confidence.

  

**The opportunity**

The Strategy & Execution team in EY-Parthenon recognizes that CEOs and business leaders are tasked with achieving maximum value for their organizations’ stakeholders in a transformative business environment. We challenge assumptions to design and deliver strategies that improve profitability, strengthen competitiveness and create long-term value.

We are looking for an experienced strategy consulting professional to join EY-Parthenon GDS India as an Associate Director within the Consumer Products and Retail sector.

You will be based in EY GDS India and work as an integrated member of the Singapore Strategy & Execution team, primarily supporting client engagements across Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.

This is a client-facing consulting and leadership role. You will work closely with EY-Parthenon teams and clients across ASEAN to develop and deliver strategic opportunities, drawing on market, competitor and customer insights and incorporating commercial, operational, financial and implementation perspectives.

The role provides the opportunity to work on complex, cross-border engagements, develop relationships with senior stakeholders and contribute to building EY-Parthenon’s Consumer Products and Retail capabilities across Singapore, ASEAN and GDS India.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Client engagement and delivery**

* Lead client engagements, major workstreams or independent modules across strategy, commercial transformation and operational transformation assignments.
* Structure complex business problems, develop hypotheses and define robust approaches to address clients’ strategic and operational priorities.
* Lead the collection and analysis of quantitative and qualitative information, translate findings into insights and formulate practical recommendations.
* Take ownership of the quality, timeliness and commercial relevance of project deliverables.
* Work directly with client stakeholders to understand their priorities, align on project objectives and communicate emerging findings and recommendations.
* Lead or contribute to client discussions, working sessions, presentations and senior stakeholder meetings.
* Develop clear, compelling and evidence-based presentations and reports for senior client audiences.
* Work effectively with geographically dispersed engagement teams, coordinating closely with colleagues in Singapore, GDS India and other ASEAN markets.

**Strategy and transformation**

You will work across a range of strategy and transformation engagements, which may include:

* Market entry and growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy
* Revenue growth management
* Commercial transformation
* Digital and AI-led transformation
* Commercial due diligence
* Post-merger integration
* Divestment strategy and execution
* Cost and organization transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial and operational transformation
* Turnaround strategy and rapid value creation

**Team leadership and capability development**

* Lead, coach and develop teams working across GDS India, Singapore and the wider EY-Parthenon network.
* Provide clear direction, constructive feedback and day-to-day support to team members.
* Contribute to building a strong Consumer Products and Retail capability within EY-Parthenon GDS India.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, learning and broader capability-development initiatives.
* Help strengthen collaboration and knowledge sharing between the Singapore and GDS India teams.
* Promote an inclusive, high-performing team environment focused on development, quality and client impact.

**Business and practice development**

* Support the development of ASEAN-focused proposals, credentials and other business-development materials.
* Contribute sector insights and subject-matter expertise to pursuit teams and client discussions.
* Help identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and support the development of new relationships.
* Contribute to the continued growth of the Strategy & Execution practice and its Consumer Products and Retail portfolio across ASEAN.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

To succeed in this role, you should be able to:

* Lead complex strategy and transformation workstreams with limited supervision.
* Combine rigorous analysis with sound commercial judgment and practical recommendations.
* Communicate complex ideas clearly and confidently to senior internal and client stakeholders.
* Build trusted working relationships across different organizations, markets and cultures.
* Manage multiple priorities and maintain high standards in a fast-paced, project-based environment.
* Lead, motivate and develop diverse teams operating across locations.
* Collaborate effectively with Singapore-based and wider ASEAN engagement teams.
* Demonstrate a strong understanding of the strategic, commercial and operational issues affecting Consumer Products and Retail businesses.
* Adapt your working approach to different client, cultural and market contexts.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor’s degree from a recognized institution. A master’s degree or MBA is preferred.
* At least six years of relevant professional experience, including significant experience in a strategy consulting firm or a closely related consulting environment.
* Demonstrated experience in the Consumer Products and Retail sector.
* Experience leading substantial workstreams, project modules or client engagements.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical and financial analysis skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing and presenting materials for senior stakeholders.
* Experience managing and developing consulting teams.
* The ability to work effectively with colleagues and clients across locations, functions and cultures.
* A willingness and ability to travel internationally in line with client and engagement requirements.

  

**Relevant Consumer Products and Retail experience**

Relevant experience should include one or more of the following areas:

* Corporate, portfolio, market entry or growth strategy
* Go-to-market strategy and commercial transformation
* Revenue growth management
* Digital and AI-led business transformation
* Cost reduction and operating-model transformation
* Supply chain and procurement transformation
* Sales and operations planning
* Retail commercial or operational transformation
* Commercial due diligence, post-merger integration or value creation

  

**Ideally, you will also have**

* Previous experience working with clients or consulting teams in Singapore, ASEAN or other international markets.
* Experience operating as part of a cross-border or globally integrated consulting team.
* Familiarity with the business environment, consumer trends and market dynamics of Singapore and the wider ASEAN region.
* Experience supporting consulting proposals, business development and client pursuits.
* Experience building sector capabilities, coaching teams or contributing to recruitment and learning initiatives.
* Strong executive presence and the ability to establish credibility with senior client stakeholders.

  

**Regional exposure and ways of working**

* The role requires close collaboration with colleagues and clients across ASEAN, with reasonable flexibility to accommodate regional engagement requirements.
* Periodic travel to Singapore and other ASEAN markets will be required, depending on client and engagement needs. This may include short-duration on-site assignments at different stages of an engagement.
* The successful candidate should be comfortable working in an integrated regional team, building relationships remotely and in person, and adapting to the requirements of cross-border client engagements.
* Strong performers may be considered for future international mobility opportunities, subject to business requirements, performance, immigration requirements and applicable firm policies.

  

**What we offer you**

We will fuel your ambition and potential with future-focused skills development that equips you with state-of-the-art methodologies and technology-enabled solutions. With more than 25,000 people in 150 countries, you will join an inclusive and empowering culture that values your uniqueness, prioritizes your wellbeing, and immerses you in the diverse thinking and cross-cultural experiences necessary to help deliver impact to clients across the globe and help build a better working world.

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
