title: Client Partner Manager
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists.  
  
**Description**  
The Client Partner Manager (CPM) will lead the Bangalore team, responsible for sourcing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with leading clients, developers, and agencies. This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.  
The CPM will oversee the Client Partner team while also managing the Platform Specialist team, who is responsible for optimizing Apple Ads accounts, maximizing revenue performance, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.  
This role will be responsible for driving a high-performance sales culture that consistently delivers against revenue targets, customer satisfaction (CSI) goals, and key performance metrics such as CPT and CPA. The CPM will lead by example, setting a high standard of execution and ensuring the team delivers extraordinary service and strategic value to all customers.  
The CPM will also ensure strong operational discipline across the team, ensuring the team are reporting their business through the correct channels, utilizing salesforce and other internal business management tools.  
In addition, the role will partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product, to provide market feedback, share customer insights, and inform product development. A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.  
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.  
Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.  
Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.  
Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.  
Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.  
Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.  
Experience in gaming app category preferred.  
Experience managing a sales team preferred  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus  
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.  
Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.

title: Senior AI Governance Specialist
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

Senior AI Governance Specialist, ASSET MANAGEMENT

Northern Trust Asset Management (NTAM) is an over a trillion-dollar investment management firm entrusted by investors around the globe to help them navigate changing market environments, so they can confidently realize their long-term objectives.

NTAM has embarked on an ambitious plan to modernize its Data and AI capabilities and embed a data-driven culture throughout the organization. The Data Governance Specialist will pride themselves in taking a customer first approach to truly make it easier for our internal customers to protect, enhance and instill trust in our data to generate insight and deliver the best client experience.

The key focus of this role is to assist the company adopt AI quickly and safely. You will turn AI governance policy and standards into practical controls, assess AI use cases and models for risk, and give business teams clear guidance on what good looks like. You will work across Data, Technology, Risk, Legal and the business, reporting to the Head of Data and Analytics.

KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Support projects and establish responsible, safe AI practice across NTAM. Responsibilities include:

**Data management**

* Check that data used in AI systems has a clear owner, documented lineage, quality checks and appropriate access controls.
* Explicit evaluation of data completeness, suitability, ownership, lineage, quality and governance
* Maintain the AI inventory and link each model to its source data, classification and retention requirements. Extend inventory coverage beyond models and use cases to AI systems, platforms, agents, agentic solutions, digital workers and vended AI capabilities

**AI model risk management**

* Work closely with the Enterprise Model Risk Management teams and Front line AI model governance team to run risk assessments on AI use cases and models, covering bias, explainability, privacy, security and third-party risk.
* Support model validation, ongoing monitoring and issue tracking in line with model risk principles (independent challenge, documentation, performance and drift thresholds).
* Assist to develop frameworks to map controls to applicable regulations and standards, such as the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF and linked up with our NT AI Policy and Standards.
* Importantly, the role is about training NTAM AI key stakeholders, ie model owner, engineers, architects and data practitioners on how to perform these actions and ensure controls are in place so that this becomes a repeatable process.

**Safe AI adoption**

* Review new AI requests, advise teams on risk tiers and required controls, and escalate high-risk cases.
* Develop guidance, templates and training that make responsible AI use easy for non-technical colleagues.
* Report governance metrics and emerging risks to senior stakeholders and the AI governance committee.

**AI telemetry and guardrail monitoring**

* Help define and maintain the telemetry that shows AI systems are behaving as intended, such as usage, prompt and output flags, policy violations, model drift, error rates and human override rates.
* Review dashboards and alerts to confirm guardrails (content filters, access limits, data loss controls) are working as expected, and investigate gaps or false positives with engineering teams.
* Log and track incidents through to resolution, and feed lessons back into controls, thresholds and risk assessments.
* Report back to Senior Management on AI portfolio telemetry to ensure that there is transparency from different AI initiatives (prioritized by risk tiering) with clear action owner, target date, closure evidence and escalation points, rather than only tracking incidents through resolution.

**Training and change management**

* Design and deliver AI governance and responsible AI training for employees, managers and technical teams, tailored to each audience.
* Lead change management for governance rollouts: stakeholder mapping, communications, champions network and feedback loops.
* Measure adoption and behavior change (training completion, policy adherence, intake quality) and adjust the approach to improve it.
* Mentor junior analysts and set practice standards for the team.
* Interface with AI Intake process to check submissions for completeness, perform initial classification and routing using defined criteria, challenge unsupported assertions or unclear ownership, and escalate incomplete or potentially higher-risk submissions
* **Cross-functional coordination:** Explicitly include Technology, Data, Privacy, Cyber, Model Risk, Operational Risk, Compliance, Legal, TPRM and business teams, with responsibility for following up on information, actions and evidence.
* **Continuous improvement:** Identify improvements to templates, trackers, reporting processes and documentation quality to make oversight more consistent, efficient and scalable.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Within 6 months: the AI inventory is complete and every use case is risk-tiered.
* Business teams get governance guidance quickly and rate the process as clear and useful.
* High-risk models have documented validation and active monitoring.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

  

* Working knowledge of data management practice: data quality, lineage, metadata, classification and privacy.
* Proven domain knowledge in financial services
* Understanding of model risk principles and the AI/ML lifecycle, including validation, monitoring and bias testing.
* Ability to read a policy or regulation and turn it into clear, testable controls.
* Strong written and verbal communication; comfortable advising senior and non-technical audiences, with a track record of delivering training and driving adoption of new ways of working.
* Practical, pragmatic mindset that enables adoption rather than blocking it.
* Bachelor's degree in data science, engineering, risk, law, business or a related field.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as financial services, healthcare or insurance.
* Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, SR 11-7 or DAMA-DMBOK.
* Certifications such as AIGP, CDMP, CRISC or CIPP.

KEY BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  

* Business acumen, and the ability to communicate to executives, business domain stakeholders and technical staff.
* Strong project management, acumen and familiarity working in agile environments.
* Experience with innovation and ideation methods, such as design thinking and product management.
* Demonstrated influence, communication, presentation, and facilitation skills.
* Demonstrate the ability to work well with others and exhibit leadership.
* Be an excellent communicator and collaborator, engaging with multiple technical and business stakeholders and leaders. Team player with collaborative and inclusive approach.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION

  

* 10+ years in data governance, model risk, technology risk, compliance or a related analytical role.
* Bachelors degree in field like Computer Science, Information technology, Math, Data Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance (with focus on analysis) etc. and/or relevant proven work experience is required

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

**Purpose of the role**

title: Digital Customer Success Manager
description:
This role sits within our Digital Customer Success team. This team exists to manage and evolve how we serve customers through digital and agentic experiences. The team helps MongoDB deliver a consistent, personalised and relevant experience using data, lifecycle programmes, automation, and human judgement where it matters most.

We are looking for a Digital Success Manager to foster high-impact customer relationships at scale by leveraging data, automation, and digital channels to deliver tailored, value-led experiences. Blending strategic insight with digital programmes, you will advance our Digital-First strategy and achieve key organizational goals.

Serving as a subject matter expert across a high volume of low-to-mid-tier accounts, you will build deep knowledge of the long tail of your assigned region, analyzing retention trends and uncovering new ways to add value. Rather than conducting traditional 1:1 meetings, you will drive customer outcomes using scalable digital check-ins, automated health-score triggers, and 1:many outreach, stepping in personally as the human-in-the-loop escalation point when judgment, nuance, or a personal touch is needed.

Because this role is still evolving, we seek an entrepreneurial self-starter who is curious, driven, and excited to take initiative, someone who is knowledgeable and excited about AI and uses it hands-on to accelerate their work, run their own research, and manage their own programmes, but also understands its limitations. In this role you will partner closely with sales and cross-functional teams to shape the future of Digital Customer Success.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram/Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

### **Who You Are**

Our ideal candidate thrives in dynamic environments, is passionate and knowledgeable about AI, and brings strong analytical skills paired with a deep, customer-centric mindset. You are:

* Regional Expert & Escalation Point: Deep, long-tail knowledge of your assigned region, you know the accounts, patterns, and risks well enough to be the human-in-the-loop escalation point when automated programmes need judgment or a personal touch
* AI-Native & Hands-On: Genuinely excited and knowledgeable about AI, and you use it in your day-to-day work, building your own dashboards, running your own research, and managing your own programmes rather than waiting on others to build the tooling for you

* Independent, Yet a Great Partner: Comfortable working independently and owning your patch, but equally strong at partnering, especially with long tail sales teams, to understand customers and co-design programmes together
* Data-Driven & Analytical: Skilled at analyzing customer trends and data to unlock value and optimize customer outcomes at scale
* Digital Channels Specialist: Experienced in using scalable 1:many digital engagement models and outreach strategies to connect with customers effectively
* Strategic Thinker: Able to translate customer insights into strategic initiatives that advance Digital-First goals and drive long-term success

Drive the regional 1:many strategy for our long tail segment, stepping in with selective 1:1 interactions where appropriate to ensure high impact
* Partner closely with sales and account teams to deeply understand customers, co-design digital-first programmes together, report regional insights, and unlock enablement opportunities, improve onboarding, and mitigate churn
* Use AI tools and techniques to build your own dashboards, conduct your own research, and manage your own programmes, bringing curiosity and initiative to how you work, not just what you deliver

### **What You'll Bring:**

* Experience: 3+ years in Customer Success or a similar role; familiarity with scaled or digital models across the onboarding and consumption phases
* AI Fluency: Genuine enthusiasm for and hands-on experience with AI tools, with a track record of using them independently to build dashboards, automate research, or manage programmes
* Mindset: Curious, driven, and entrepreneurial, comfortable building processes from scratch and developing innovative solutions that deliver measurable results, while working both independently and as a strong partner to others
* Collaboration Skills: Proven ability to work cross-functionally, particularly with sales teams, and align objectives across diverse stakeholders
* Adaptability: Comfortable navigating fast-moving shifts in scope, strategy, and goals
* Tech-Savviness: Familiarity with the tools and technologies that support digital engagement (e.g., automation tools, CRMs, CS software)

### **About MongoDB**

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB.

From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

**Lab Automation Specialist**

  

At bp, we provide an excellent working environment and employee benefits such as an open and inclusive culture, a great work-life balance, tremendous learning and development opportunities to craft your career path, life and health insurance, medical care package and many others.

**Job Purpose**

Working as part of the Lab Automation, LIMS & Data Management team, the role acts as a key interface between laboratory stakeholders and technical delivery teams, ensuring automation solutions are aligned with business objectives, laboratory operations, safety requirements, and user expectations.

Working closely with scientists, laboratory teams, automation specialists, digital teams, and external partners, the role is responsible for gathering and documenting business requirements, analysing laboratory workflows, and translating user needs into clear requirements that support automation delivery.

* Support the definition of project scope, objectives, requirements, and success criteria for laboratory automation initiatives.
* Document business, process, functional, and data requirements using agreed standards and methodologies.
* Develop and maintain current-state and future-state process maps.
* Analyse laboratory workflows to find opportunities to improve safety, efficiency, quality, data integrity, and user experience through automation.
* Work with wider team, Robotics specialists, Digital Security, Digital delivery, system integrators, and suppliers to translate requirements into solution specifications.
* Support solution evaluations, testing, validation, deployment, and operational handover activities.

**Essential Education & Experience**

* Experience in business analysis, process & workflow improvement, laboratory operations, automation, manufacturing, or another technical environment.
* Experience gathering, documenting, and handling business and user requirements.
* Project management experience
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process mapping skills.
* Experience working with stakeholders and facilitating discussions across multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  

  

**Desirable Education & Experience**

description:
**Own Every Moment at NetApp**

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure—delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud.

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function.

**Mgr, People Consultant**
==========================

Bengaluru, India

**Job category:** Human Resources **Job ID:** 136746-en\_US

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are recharging how HR delivers impact at NetApp.

As the Senior Manager, People Consultant, you will lead the People Consultant team in APAC and directly manage complex employee relations, performance management, and workplace matters. You will be accountable for regional service delivery, team capability, workload management, and case quality while contributing to the continued development of the global People Consultant operating model.

You will strengthen manager capability and ensure employee matters are addressed with sound judgment, appropriate speed, and clear accountability. You will use case trends, workload data, and local insights to improve team effectiveness, identify emerging risks, and inform scalable improvements to the global People Consultant model.

About the People Consultant Team

The People Consultant team is chartered to empower and enable people managers through targeted coaching, proactively resolve employee relations risks, and seamlessly execute critical HR programs to foster a high-performing, compliant, and supportive workplace. Responsibilities include:

Elevate manager decision quality through expert coaching, performance management guidance, and real-time advisory on complex employee situations

Translate case insights into scalable solutions, working with the HR Leadership team to identify systemic gaps and drive improvements in policies, tools, training, and HR programs

Act as a critical feedback loop for the business, surfacing trends and insights that inform Talent, HR, and business strategy

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead the APAC People Consultant team and establish clear priorities, operating rhythms, workload allocation, quality standards, and development plans.
* Lead and develop People Consultants through regular case reviews, feedback, and development planning, strengthening judgment, documentation quality, manager guidance, escalation decisions, and effective resolution.
* Directly manage the most complex or sensitive employee relations, performance management, workplace conflict, and investigation follow-up matters.
* Provide expert consultation to managers on performance concerns, documented coaching, performance improvement plans, workplace expectations, conflict resolution, and difficult employee conversations.
* Support early resolution of employee and workplace concerns that do not require a formal investigation, including mediation, relationship issues, communication concerns, and recurring manager or team friction.
* Partner with Employment Legal and Investigations on appropriate triage, investigation close-out, corrective action, and manager follow-through, while limiting escalations to matters that require their authority or expertise.
* Maintain clear operating boundaries and handoffs across People Consultants, HR Operations, HR Business Partners, Legal, Investigations, and specialist teams.
* Monitor case demand, complexity, capacity, cycle time, escalation patterns, and recurring themes to balance workload across the team, adjust assignments and priorities, identify performance or capability gaps, and ensure timely, consistent delivery.
* Use case insights to identify emerging risks, capability gaps, and opportunities for manager enablement, policy or process improvements, tools, training, and broader HR solutions.
* Build strong relationships with business leaders and HR partners while contributing to a consistent global People Consultant operating model.
* Support the continued development of the People Consultant function, including designing workflows, service standards, measures of success, and scalable ways of working.

**Job Requirement**
-------------------

* 8 or more years of relevant HR experience, including significant experience in employee relations, performance management, HR business partnership, or a comparable people advisory role.
* People Leadership: 4 or more years of people management responsibility, with demonstrated experience developing professionals, managing performance, allocating work, and leading teams responsible for moderately complex, sensitive, and judgment-based matters.
* India Expertise: Experience supporting a complex organization in India, with strong knowledge of local employment practices, cultural considerations, and manager needs.
* Cross-Functional Partnership: Experience partnering effectively with Employment Legal, Investigations, HR Operations, HR Business Partners, and business leaders.
* Other Qualifications
* Leadership and Team Development: Ability to establish priorities, operating objectives, work plans, and quality standards while developing talent and creating accountability for results.
* Judgment and Decision Making: Sound judgment in situations where facts may be incomplete, problems are not clearly defined, or multiple risks and stakeholder interests must be balanced.
* Employee Relations Expertise: Deep understanding of employee relations, corrective performance management, workplace conflict, manager coaching, and investigation follow-up.
* Legal and Compliance Knowledge: Ability to interpret policies and practices consistently while accounting for local legal, regulatory, and cultural requirements.
* Business Acumen: Ability to connect people decisions to team effectiveness, employee experience, risk, and business outcomes.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to influence stakeholders in sensitive and complex situations, build trusted relationships, and communicate clear recommendations, risks, and trade-offs.
* Operating Model Clarity: Ability to distinguish among manager-owned decisions, People Consultant advisory work, HRBP strategic partnership, HR Operations execution, and matters requiring Legal or Investigations involvement.
* Analytical and Operational Discipline: Ability to use case data, workload patterns, and recurring themes to improve service delivery, identify root causes, and inform scalable solutions.

title: Associate Manager, Market Development
description:
Overview:

Reporting to the Head of Sales, South Asia, the Associate Manager, Market Development, will be a key member of the Global Sales organization responsible for driving market growth, demand generation, and revenue execution across the South Asia region.

The role will focus on expanding Shure's presence within the Collaboration and Conferencing ecosystem by developing strategic relationships with end users, consultants, system integrators, distribution partners, and alliance partners. Leveraging market intelligence, competitive insights, and customer engagement, this individual will help build pipeline, accelerate specifications, and drive adoption of Shure's collaboration, conferencing, networked audio, and enterprise solutions portfolio.  
This position can be based in Bangalore or Hyderabad.

Responsibilities:

**Revenue Growth & Pipeline Development**  

* Drive business development, pipeline creation, and revenue growth within the Collaboration and Conferencing market to support regional sales objectives and long-term business growth.
* Identify, prioritize, and develop strategic opportunities, key accounts, and emerging market segments to expand Shure's customer base and specification influence.
* Work closely with sales leadership, distribution partners, and system integrators to accelerate opportunity conversion and improve win rates.

**End-User & Ecosystem Engagement**  

* Develop strong relationships with end users, consultants, technology influencers, and channel partners to position Shure as the preferred audio and collaboration solutions provider.
* Promote Shure's complete ecosystem, including conferencing, collaboration, networked audio, wireless, and software offerings, to drive cross-portfolio adoption and attachment opportunities.
* Influence project specifications and technology recommendations through proactive customer engagement and solution-based selling.

**Partner Enablement & Capability Development**  

* Plan and deliver training, workshops, demonstrations, and enablement programs for distribution partners, consultants, and integration partners.
* Strengthen partner capabilities around Shure solutions, value proposition, competitive positioning, and sales motions.
* Measure the effectiveness of enablement activities and recommend actions to improve partner engagement and conversion.

**Market Activation & Demand Generation**  

* Collaborate with Marketing and Market Activation teams to execute customer events, roadshows, industry conferences, webinars, and thought leadership initiatives.
* Support local demand-generation campaigns that increase market awareness, create qualified opportunities, and strengthen customer engagement.
* Represent Shure at key industry events and customer-facing activities throughout the region.

**Business Intelligence & Strategic Planning**

* Provide market insights, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and regional trends to support sales strategy, portfolio planning, and go-to-market decisions.
* Support forecasting, pipeline reviews, account planning, and business reviews through data-driven insights and opportunity analysis.
* Monitor competitive developments and recommend actions to strengthen Shure's market position and accelerate growth.

**Travel**  

* Ability to travel minimum 50% of the time, including occasional weekends, as business needs require.

  
Qualifications:

* Proven success driving business development, revenue growth, and strategic account expansion within the Integrated Systems, Unified Communications, or professional AV industry.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience with 8-10 years of relevant experience in professional audio, collaboration technologies, or audiovisual solutions.
* Strong understanding of Integrated Systems markets, including Audio Visual Integration, Unified Communications, Collaboration Solutions, Networked Audio, Video Conferencing, and Multi-Language Discussion Systems.
* Demonstrated ability to influence complex buying decisions and build relationships across end users, consultants, integrators, distributors, and alliance partners.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to analyze market trends, identify growth opportunities, and develop actionable sales strategies.
* Excellent presentation, communication, and customer engagement skills, with the ability to articulate business value to both technical and executive audiences.
* Experience with audio system design, DSP platforms, conferencing technologies, and enterprise collaboration solutions is highly desirable.
* Self-motivated, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office tools, CRM platforms, and pipeline management processes.
* Native language fluency appropriate for the region with excellent spoken and written English.

**WHO WE ARE**

Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.

Join Shure and **Amplify Your Impact.** Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.

**THE MIX MATTERS**

We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

Above all, you take ownership, show initiative, and are passionate about delivering high-quality digital products that make a difference.
  
  
Furthermore, we believe that you bring:
  

* Strong Experience in Business Steering solutions such as Market Share, Service optimisation, PnL …
* Strong experience in leading cross-functional product and engineering teams
* Experience leading teams across the full cycle of a product build journey
* Good understanding of software engineering principles and modern development practices
* Experience working with agile methodologies and outcome-oriented ways of working
* Ability to define and measure success through KPIs and OKRs
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
* Understanding of cost drivers in software delivery and the impact of technical decisions
* A passion for digital product delivery, innovation, and continuous improvement
* Proven ability to define a meaningful product roadmap even in contexts where the end-state is not yet determined
* Able to lead teams through uncertainty, with transparency and care

Key responsibilities (title) A day in your life with us

Key responsibilities (text) As a Platform Product Delivery Manager, you will be responsible for driving the full lifecycle of digital products – from discovery and development to deployment and operations – ensuring they deliver value to the business and our customers. You will work closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to secure alignment, remove obstacles, and ensure seamless delivery across teams and dependencies. You will also play a key role in building strong, high-performing teams and enabling ways of working that support speed, quality, and continuous improvement.
  
  
To be concrete, you will:
  

* Own the end-to-end delivery lifecycle of digital products (discovery development deployment operations adoption pivot/persevere decisions)
* Drive product and engineering execution, including prioritisation, delivery speed, and quality
* Promote modern engineering practices such as automation and continuous improvement
* Ensure operational excellence, including availability, performance, and compliance requirements
* Remove blockers and manage cross-team dependencies to enable smooth delivery flow
* Lead and develop high-performing teams, fostering ownership, accountability, and collaboration
* Use data, KPIs, and insights to drive decisions and continuously improve outcomes
* Contribute to reducing technical debt and improving long-term product sustainability
* Lead through change and uncertainty with a structured, pragmatic, and positive mindset

Team vision ( title) Together as a team

Team vision (text) You will be part of Group Digital, where we set the digital agenda to keep IKEA leading in a fast-moving and uncertain world. We develop and operate digital products and platforms that support the entire IKEA value chain and enable better experiences for both customers and co-workers.
  
You will work in Group Function Digital Area. The Digital Area – Group Functions is a new area built to strengthen digital partnership and delivery across all Group Functions and Global Business Operations (GBO). We develop and deliver digital capabilities across key areas like Finance, People & Culture, Procurement, Legal, Business Risk & Compliance, Communications, Real Estate, and Business Steering in Ingka's global organisation.

### **Why you will love us**

From the deep forests in Sweden, we have spread our culture and values around the world. At the heart of our offer are our beautiful home-furnishing products and solutions, made with care for our planet, reaching millions of customers.

  

At the heart of our business, are our wonderful co-workers representing diversity in all dimensions and passionate for life at home. We all contribute with our uniqueness and we want to grow and develop together.

  

Our vision, “to create a better everyday life for the many people” inspires and guides us in everything we do. This is IKEA.

### **What we all have in common**

* Living our values
* Being your unique self, while respecting and including others
* A passion for home furnishing
* Performing & delivering while learning & developing
* Having fun!

title: Systems Engineering Manager
description:
**About the role**  

As a Systems Engineer Manager you are the first systems engineering management role. You impact positively the teams you lead, the people you manage and the products you are responsible for whilst helping build the right culture within your domain. You hire, develop, and retain our System Engineers to set them up for success. You build performing teams that consistently deliver quality outcomes, whilst empowering your engineers to own technical decisions. You work effectively with your stakeholders and product teams to ensure the right outcomes are delivered. You play a key role in formulating the technical strategy and roadmap for your area.

Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities:

I play an active role in people management and technical leadership. I impact the teams I lead, the people I manage and the products I am responsible for, whilst having a direct impact upon the environment and continuous improvement within my domain. I am responsible for building and developing high performing teams. I take accountability for the environment that my teams operate within and the processes and standards that facilitate high quality systems delivery. Ensuring the right product outcomes through the right technical strategy and trade-offs. I build capability by hiring, retaining, and developing the careers of our engineers, ensuring opportunities for growth, and maintaining a level of challenge and motivation.

I establish and sustain the environment for development to succeed. My primary focus is to hire, develop and retain our Systems Engineers (SEs). I lead and develop our SEs through tailored plans, 1-2-1 meetings, coaching and mentoring whilst aligning opportunities to grow expertise alongside the goals of the wider team and business. I ensure SEs are set up for success and provide course corrections when needed.

I am responsible for building performing teams that consistently deliver quality systems whilst balancing the demands of timeframes and needs. I ensure the right levels of processes, practices, and standards to configure and operate products, aligned to the wider Technology strategy and standards. I involve in evaluation and recommend appropriate products to meet business needs. I drive continuous improvement across my teams and directorate, capturing the right data to affect our practices and delivery. I guide and empower my engineers to own technical decisions whilst understanding when guidance is needed.

I play a major role in the process of releasing value to our customers. I am accountable for the products I work on and proactively identify risks, propose mitigations, and understand when to escalate or ask for help. I build balanced, empathetic relationships with my stakeholders and product teams, collaborating effectively to ensure the right outcomes are delivered. I am a great communicator.

I play a key role in formulating the technical strategy and roadmap for my area to support the growth of our business objectives and maintaining our competitive advantage. I drive architecture, design, implementation,

**You will need**  

Experience managing systems engineers, supporting their career development and growth.

Solid experience of designing end to end architecture of one or more enterprise level solutions in HR domain.

Experience in leading large and complex packaged apps implementations in HR

Demonstrated experience designing, configuring, and running highly scalable systems.

Experience implementing a range of design and architecture patterns.

Experience of technical leadership within a team. Coaching, supporting, and mentoring those around me.

Should have experience in people management and should have managed large scale implementation / support projects

Should have experienced Oracle HCM Cloud Consultant with strong expertise in Absence Management, Core HR configuration, Security, and Workforce Structures. Skilled in designing and implementing enterprise structures including Legal Entities, LDGs, TRUs, Jobs, Grades, Positions, Departments, and Locations. Proven experience in configuring Absence Plans, Absence Types, Reasons, Certifications, workflows, approvals, and security roles for large-scale Oracle HCM Cloud implementations.

  
**Whats in it for you?**  

At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you.

As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day.

Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.

Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable.

**Salary** - Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment.

**Leave & Time-off** - Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy.

**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary** - In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF.

**Health is Wealth** - Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws.

**Mental Wellbeing** - We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.

**Financial Wellbeing** - Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.

**Save As You Earn (SAYE)** - Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.

**Physical Wellbeing** - Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle.

**About Us**  

At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve.

At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed.

We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.

When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

Our mission is simple. End Cyber Risk. We're looking for an **Engineering Manager** to be part of making this happen.
  
  
**Position Overview and Objective**  
  
The Engineering Manager will contribute to our **Sensor Platform Delivery team** by leading the site reliability engineering (SRE), quality assurance (QA), lab infrastructure, and release rollout functions that take our network security sensor platform from a passing build to a healthy, verified state across thousands of sensors deployed in customer environments worldwide.
  
  
**Responsibilities**  
  
**AS AN ENGINEERING MANAGER AT ARCTIC WOLF, YOU WILL:**

* Lead the engineering teams across site reliability engineering (SRE), quality assurance (QA), lab infrastructure, and release rollout for our network security sensor platform.
* Own release criteria and rollout decisions for firmware, kernel, and service updates across our global sensor fleet, including staged rolling deployments and rollback calls.
* Drive fleet reliability targets, including availability, upgrade success rate, and data flow continuity, across multi region cloud infrastructure on AWS.
* Oversee the physical lab environment, including build servers, power distribution units (PDUs), and virtualized test fleets, keeping lab configuration aligned with production.
* Manage CI/CD pipelines and automated test frameworks spanning unit, integration, simulation, and full physical system testing, and reduce flaky tests to improve signal quality.
* Partner with infrastructure and security teams on container orchestration, database management, and core networking protocols, including TCP/IP and port mirroring, to support sensor telemetry and detection workflows.
* Build and maintain the runbooks, dashboards, and on-call processes that your team, solution engineers, and solution architects depend on during incident response.
* Mentor and grow a team of engineers, strengthening people management practices and cross functional partnership with solution engineering managers and solution architects.

**Experience and Requirements**  
  
**YOUR EXPERIENCE MIGHT LOOK LIKE:**

* 10- 15 yrs of experience which should include 5+ years in software engineering, including 2 or more years managing engineering teams.
* Hands on experience with test infrastructure, lab environments, and CI/CD pipelines, including debugging across physical and virtualized systems.
* A track record in release engineering and platform reliability, with experience improving release confidence across distributed systems.
* Experience operating services on AWS, including container orchestration and managed database administration.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP and port mirroring, and of security protocols relevant to network security appliances.
* Experience managing or partnering closely with QA and DevOps functions, and comfort working alongside solution engineers and solution architects.
* Strong written communication skills, with experience producing runbooks, postmortems, and release notes that on-call engineers depend on.

**On-Camera Policy**

We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. **About Arctic Wolf**  
  
At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
  
  
**Our Values**  
  
Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that, by protecting people's and organizations' sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk, we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
  
  
We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance.
  
  
We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.

title: IGA Engineer
description:
**About Chubb**

Chubb is a world leader in insurance. With operations in 54 countries and territories, Chubb provides commercial and personal property and casualty insurance, personal accident and supplemental health insurance, reinsurance and life insurance to a diverse group of clients. The company is defined by its extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength and local operations globally. Parent company Chubb Limited is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: CB) and is a component of the S&P 500 index. Chubb employs approximately 40,000 people worldwide. Additional information can be found at: http://www.chubb.com/

**About Chubb India**

At Chubb India, we are on an exciting journey of digital transformation driven by a commitment to engineering excellence and analytics. With a team of over 2500 talented professionals, we foster a startup mindset that promotes collaboration, diverse perspectives, and a solution-driven attitude. We are dedicated to building expertise in engineering, analytics, and automation, empowering our teams to excel in a dynamic digital landscape. We offer an environment where you will be part of an organisation that is dedicated to solving real-world challenges in the insurance industry. Together, we will work to shape the future through innovation and continuous learning.

**Position Details:**

**Job Title:** IGA Engineer

**Function/Department:** Security Engineering

**Location:** Hyderabad, Bangalore

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking an experienced Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) Engineer to design, develop, and configure robust identity management solutions on Chubb’s SailPoint IdentityNow (ISC) platform. In this role you will integrate the IGA platform with enterprise systems, build and maintain automated lifecycle processes, configure access certification campaigns, and contribute to the ongoing migration of applications from the legacy OIM platform to new platform. You will work closely with global IAM and project teams to translate business requirements into secure, scalable technical configurations that streamline access control across the organisation. This role follows a hybrid working model based in India.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform end-to-end IGA application onboarding and development on SailPoint ISC, including access request catalogue configuration, UI customisations, access policy design, role management, and custom rule development.
* Configure and maintain SailPoint ISC connectors — including Active Directory / Entra ID, SCIM, JDBC, REST, and web-service connectors — to support seamless user lifecycle management across enterprise applications.
* Develop and maintain BeanShell rules, Transform rules, and Provisioning Policies within SailPoint ISC to support custom lifecycle, aggregation, and provisioning logic.
* Design and support Identity Lifecycle Manager (LCM) processes — joiner, mover, leaver — ensuring automation aligns with HR and business-defined triggers.
* Configure and manage Access Certification (campaign) and Access Review processes to meet audit and compliance requirements.
* Integrate SailPoint ISC with enterprise platforms including Entra ID (Azure AD), PAM products, ServiceNow (ITSM), and other enterprise systems using REST APIs and SailPoint PAT-based authentication.
* Partner with project teams to understand business requirements, translate them into technical designs, and validate solutions end-to-end.
* Support the ongoing migration of applications from Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) to SailPoint ISC, reviewing legacy OIM connector configurations and re-engineering them for ISC.
* Build and maintain automated monitoring capabilities to support system health and security compliance.
* Troubleshoot platform issues, resolve defects, and ensure stable performance of the IGA platform.
* Collaborate with cross-functional global teams — IAM Engineering, onboarding teams, Application teams, Audit, and ServiceNow — to deliver secure, efficient, and scalable identity solutions.
* Support ongoing platform enhancements, continuous improvement initiatives, and technical debt remediation.

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent experience in Identity Governance and Administration engineering
* 6-12 years of hands-on IGA engineering experience, with demonstrated ability to deliver independently on assigned workstreams while collaborating effectively with global team members and stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with SailPoint IdentityNow / ISC (required) — including Access Request, Lifecycle Manager, Certifications, Roles, Connectors, and the SailPoint ISC REST API. SailPoint IdentityNow Certified Engineer credential is strongly preferred.
* Experience with Oracle Identity Manager (OIM) is an advantage — knowledge of OIM connector types, adapter configuration, and reconciliation is valued in the context of OIM-to-ISC migration projects.
* Scripting proficiency in BeanShell and/or Java for IGA rule development within SailPoint ISC; REST API and JSON fluency for platform integrations and connector development.
* Experience working with Entra ID (Azure AD) and on-premises Active Directory, including connector configuration, group and role management, and lifecycle event handling.
* Experience with REST APIs and web services to enable system connectivity, automate identity-related processes, and support secure data exchange across enterprise applications.
* Experience integrating IGA platforms with ServiceNow for access request fulfilment and ticketing workflows is strongly preferred.
* Direct experience with SailPoint ISC connector types, including:
  + Active Directory / Entra ID Connector
  + SCIM 2.0 Connector
  + JDBC / Database Connector
  + Web Service / REST Connector
  + Virtual Appliance (VA) management
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills; ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams in a global, matrixed environment.
Experience working in agile/scrum delivery models within a global IAM team, including sprint planning, story estimation, and iterative release cycles.  

**Why Join Us?**

* Be at the forefront of digital transformation in the insurance industry.
* Lead impactful initiatives that simplify claims processing and enhance customer satisfaction.
Work alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.  

**Why Chubb?**

Join Chubb to be part of a leading global insurance company!

Our constant focus on employee experience, along with a start-up-like culture, empowers you to achieve impactful results.

* Industry leader: Chubb is a world leader in the insurance industry, powered by underwriting and engineering excellence
* A Great Place to Work: Chubb India has been recognised as a Great Place to Work® for the years 2023-2024, 2024-2025 and 2025-2026
* Laser focus on excellence: At Chubb, we pride ourselves on our culture of greatness, where excellence is a mindset and a way of being. We constantly seek new and innovative ways to excel at work and deliver outstanding results
* Start-Up Culture: Embracing the spirit of a start-up, our focus on speed and agility enables us to respond swiftly to market requirements, while a culture of ownership empowers employees to drive results that matter
Growth and success: As we continue to grow, we are steadfast in our commitment to provide our employees with the best work experience, enabling them to advance their careers in a conducive environment  

**Employee Benefits**

Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and professional growth. Employees enjoy flexible work options, generous paid time off, and robust health coverage, including treatment for dental and vision-related requirements. We invest in the future of our employees through continuous learning opportunities and career advancement programs, while fostering a supportive and inclusive work environment. Our benefits include:

* Savings and Investment plans: We provide specialised benefits like Corporate NPS (National Pension Scheme), Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), Long-Term Incentive Plan (LTIP), Retiral Benefits and Car Lease that help employees optimally plan their finances
* Upskilling and career growth opportunities: With a focus on continuous learning, we offer customised programs that support upskilling like Education Reimbursement Programs, Certification programs and access to global learning programs.
Health and Welfare Benefits: We care about our employees’ well-being in and out of work and have benefits like a hybrid work environment, an Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Yearly Free Health campaigns and comprehensive Insurance benefits.  

**Application Process**

Our recruitment process is designed to be transparent and inclusive.

Step 1: Submit your application via the Chubb Careers Portal.

Step 2: Engage with our recruitment team for an initial discussion.

Step 3: Participate in HackerRank assessments/technical/functional interviews and assessments (if applicable).

Step 4: Final interaction with Chubb leadership.

**Join Us**

With you, Chubb is better. Whether you are solving challenges on a global stage or creating innovative solutions for local markets, your contributions will help shape the future. If you value integrity, innovation, and inclusion, and are ready to make a difference, we invite you to be part of Chubb India’s journey.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

title: Manager – Professional Services
description:
**Manager – Professional Services**

**Experience:** 8+ years **Location:** Bengaluru (Onsite)

  

**Role Summary**

SecPod is seeking a customer-focused Manager – Professional Services to lead the team responsible for implementing the Saner Platform across enterprise customer environments.

You will lead engagements from discovery and scoping through deployment, adoption and operational handover. You will also develop the Professional Services team, strengthen delivery practices, and guide project governance, customer change management and services scoping to ensure engagements meet customer goals and SecPod’s delivery commitments.

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead the Professional Services Team**

* Lead, coach and develop Professional Services engineers, setting clear expectations for delivery quality, customer engagement and accountability.
* Plan team capacity and assign resources across engagements, balancing customer priorities, technical skills and timelines.
Build consistent implementation methods, standards, documentation and knowledge-sharing practices.  

  

**Govern Project Delivery and Customer Change**

* Oversee enterprise implementations from discovery and planning through deployment, validation, training and operational handover.
* Establish project governance, including scope, success criteria, milestones, dependencies, resource plans, customer responsibilities and status reporting.
* Track risks, issues, decisions and scope changes; identify delivery concerns early and lead corrective or recovery plans.
* Align deployments with customer change processes, approvals, maintenance windows, security requirements and operational constraints.
Coordinate customer readiness, testing, deployment planning, training, adoption and acceptance.  

  

**Lead Services Scoping and Commercial Planning**

* Develop customized Professional Services scopes based on customer requirements, solution design, delivery complexity and desired outcomes.
* Define deliverables, assumptions, exclusions, dependencies, resource mix, effort estimates and timelines.
* Develop costing and pricing inputs for services proposals with Sales, Finance and leadership, following SecPod’s commercial guidelines and approval process.
Present and explain proposed scope, effort, timelines and pricing to customers, aligning expectations before work begins.  

  

* Assess scope changes for their impact on cost, resources, deliverables and timelines; coordinate proposals and approvals before additional work proceeds.
* Review estimated and actual delivery effort to improve future scoping and estimation accuracy.

**Provide Technical and Customer Guidance**

* Guide the team in designing Saner deployments across on-premises, cloud and hybrid environments.
* Provide technical oversight for implementations involving vulnerability and patch management, compliance, asset discovery and related security capabilities.
* Support the team in resolving complex implementation and integration challenges.
Help customers align implementation plans with their security, operational and remediation goals.  

  

**Work Across SecPod**

* Partner with Sales on discovery, solution scoping, estimates, proposals and handover to confirm requirements and delivery readiness.
* Coordinate with Customer Success and Support to ensure clear ownership and a smooth transition after implementation.
Work with Product and Engineering to share customer feedback and address recurring deployment challenges.  

  

**What You’ll Bring**

* 8+ years of experience in Professional Services, cybersecurity implementation, technical consulting, Technical Account Management or a related customer-facing technical role.
* At least 3 years of experience leading or mentoring technical teams.
* Experience managing multiple enterprise implementations and customer stakeholders.
* Strong project management skills, including planning, scope and schedule control, risk and dependency management, governance and stakeholder communication.
* Experience developing customized services scopes, estimating effort and resources, and contributing to project costing and pricing.
* Experience preparing or reviewing proposals, Statements of Work or similar documents, and discussing scope, estimates and pricing with customers.
* Understanding of cybersecurity platforms and enterprise implementation practices, particularly vulnerability management, patch management or compliance.
* Ability to guide technical teams and oversee deployments across on-premises, cloud or hybrid environments.
* Strong customer communication, problem-solving and escalation-management skills.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.  

  

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with structured, Agile or hybrid project delivery approaches.
* Familiarity with customer IT change control, deployment approvals and change advisory boards.
Exposure to enterprise technologies such as Windows and Linux, Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID, endpoint management, ITSM platforms, security integrations or public cloud platforms.  

  

* PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent project management certification; relevant cybersecurity, cloud or change management certifications are also valued.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Implementations meet agreed scope, timelines and quality expectations, and customers are prepared to operate the solution after handover.
* Delivery risks and scope changes are identified early and managed with clear ownership and timely decisions.
* Scopes and estimates are accurate, appropriately resourced and aligned with customer outcomes and delivery capacity.
* Team capacity, delivery quality, customer feedback and estimation accuracy improve over time.
Reusable implementation practices help improve delivery consistency and reduce time to deploy.  

  

**Why Join SecPod**

* Partner with enterprise customers across industries to deliver impactful cybersecurity solutions.
* Lead the implementation and adoption of the Saner Platform across vulnerability and exposure management.
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and Support to improve customer outcomes and the implementation experience.

Job Details

**About BHIVE Workspace**

BHIVE Workspace is one of Bengaluru’s leading flexible workspace providers. Founded in 2014, BHIVE has grown into a homegrown brand that offers coworking spaces, managed offices and enterprise workspace solutions across key business districts in the city. We serve thousands of members, from early-stage startups and freelancers to large enterprises and global companies.

Our goal is to make great workspaces accessible, so that businesses of every size can grow without the cost and complexity of traditional real estate. Beyond workspaces, BHIVE is building a wider real estate ecosystem that includes investment-led platforms.

BHIVE is in a strong growth phase, opening new centres and expanding our portfolio across Bengaluru. You’ll have real ownership, work closely with leadership, and help shape how India’s next generation of businesses works.

**Why join us**

* Join a well-established brand with 30+ centres across Bengaluru’s prime business hubs

* Be part of a fast-growing, founder-led company with a big expansion roadmap

* Take on high-ownership roles with visible impact and direct access to leadership

* Work in a collaborative, entrepreneurial culture where ideas move quickly

* Learn across real estate, hospitality, sales and technology

**About the Role**

The CEO’s Office doesn’t own a single function; it drives the CEO’s agenda across Finance, Strategy, Investor Relations, Real Estate, Revenue and Marketing. You will own complete workstreams end to end – from driving the organisation’s goal-setting to fixing the processes and controls that influence those goals. You’ll run your workstreams independently, with direct visibility to the CEO and leadership. This is a senior role in the CEO’s Office, sitting one level below the Chief of Staff, with the autonomy and mandate to shape how the company executes.

**Why this role matters now**

BHIVE is at a pivotal point. If we hit our execution milestones over the next two years, we can move into a very different league of growth – and how we execute in these two years will shape the next ten years for the company. What stands between us and the desired future state is mostly execution gaps and complex, org-level problems. This role exists to close them. If that excites you, the impact this position can have is huge.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Org goals and execution:** Drive the annual and quarterly goal-setting process with leadership, and own tracking and reviews against those goals, driving the whole organisation towards execution.

* **Process efficiency:** Find and fix inefficiencies in commercial and operational processes, owning each from diagnosis through to an implemented, measurable improvement.

* **Payouts and controls:** Verify that payouts and internal controls work as intended; identify gaps and own the fixes through to closure with the relevant teams.

* **Initiative tracking:** Track whether key initiatives are succeeding – define success measures upfront, review outcomes honestly, and push for course correction early.

* **Cross-functional delivery:** Own cross-departmental programmes so that work comes together rather than falling between teams; align owners, resolve conflicts and hold teams to timelines.

* **Leadership review cadences:** Run the CEO’s Office review cadences independently, so leadership forums focus on decisions and accountability rather than status updates.

* **Decision-shaping analysis:** Lead analyses on financials, MIS, cash flow and business performance that inform leadership decisions, and contribute to board and investor work with Finance.

* **Complex org-level problems:** Take ownership of complex, ambiguous problems as they emerge and drive them to resolution, including the design and rollout of policies and process changes.

**What Success look like**

* **In 90 days:** You have taken full ownership of two to three workstreams from the Chief of Staff, delivered your first process improvements, and put clear goals and tracking in place for the current quarter.

* **In 12 months:** Annual and quarterly org goals are clearly set and tracked; multiple process improvements have been delivered with measurable impact; and leadership sees you as the go-to owner for complex cross-functional problems within the areas you’re handling.

**What you’ll need**

* **Education & Experience:** Full-time MBA with 4–6 years of total experience, including at least 2 years post-MBA, with preference for foundations in consulting, analytics, finance, or a fast-paced operating role.

* **Ownership Mindset:** A track record of owning complete workstreams end to end and delivering outcomes with minimal oversight.

* **Structured Thinking:** Able to break a problem into parts from first principles, gather relevant information, and put together a clear, organised output.

* **Business & Financial Acumen:** Comfortable reading financial statements, cash flow and unit economics; strong Excel and PowerPoint.

* **Execution & Follow-through:** Proven ability to drive several complex initiatives to closure in parallel, holding stakeholders to their commitments.

* **Communication:** Clear written and verbal communication; able to influence and, where needed, challenge senior leaders across teams.

* **Adaptability:** Willing to move between ops and strategy work as priorities shift, week to week.

* **Discretion:** Trusted with confidential financial, investor and people information.

**Good to haves**

* **Industry exposure:** Flex workspace / coworking, commercial real estate, hospitality / other multi-location, asset-heavy businesses.

* **Relevant experience:** Strategy or operations consulting / a founder’s or CEO’s office / strategy roles in high-growth companies.

* **Functional depth:** Finance or strategy specialisation; exposure to financial models, MIS, FP&A, or fundraise/board work. A CA qualification is a plus.

* **AI fluency:** Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude) as a daily working habit for research, drafting, analysis, and speeding up ops/strategy work.

**What you’ll get**

* A front-row seat to how the CEO and leadership team run the business, including board and investor work.

* Regular, direct exposure to the CEO as well as the Chief of Staff – you’ll present your own work in leadership forums, not just support it.

This role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, and client management skills, along with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

As a CLM AMS Portfolio Lead/Manager, you will contribute to the growth and success of Deloitte Tax LLP in a variety of way, including:

**Solutions**

* Design, configure, and implement changes or upgrades to CLM platforms (e.g., Icertis, Conga, DocuSign CLM, Agiloft), ensuring alignment with client requirements and best practices.
* Specialize in resolving issues pertaining to customer-specific configuration and third-party integration. Guide the team in providing innovative solutions and workarounds.
* Collaborate with clients and internal leadership to understand business objectives and translate them into system strategies, configurations, or enhancements.
* Stay current on CLM technology trends and best practices to provide innovative solutions to clients. Share insights and best practices with both clients and internal teams.

**Support**

**Business Development**

* Contribute to business development efforts, including proposal development, client presentations, and identifying opportunities for expanding AMS services.

**The team**
